3.2 智能错误诊断系统
// 错误诊断器实现
class ErrorDiagnosticSystem {
  private readonly rules: DiagnosticRule[];
  
  constructor() {
    this.rules = this.loadDiagnosticRules();
  
  /**
   * 诊断代码错误
   */
  async diagnoseCodeErrors(code: string): Promise<DiagnosticReport> {
    const diagnostics: Diagnostic[] = [];
    
    // 1. 语法错误检查
    const syntaxErrors = await this.checkSyntaxErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...syntaxErrors);
    
    // 2. 结构错误检查
    const structureErrors = await this.checkStructureErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...structureErrors);
    
    // 3. 类型错误检查
    const typeErrors = await this.checkTypeErrors(code);
    diagnostics.push(...typeErrors);
    
    // 4. 生成诊断报告
      timestamp: new Date(),
      totalErrors: diagnostics.length,
      errorsBySeverity: this.groupBySeverity(diagnostics),
      suggestions: this.generateSuggestions(diagnostics),
      diagnostics
  
  /**
   * 加载诊断规则
   */
  private loadDiagnosticRules(): DiagnosticRule[] {
    return [
      // JSON语法规则
        id: "json-syntax-001",
        pattern: /,[\s\r\n]*]/,
        message: "移除尾随逗号",
        severity: "error"
      // 类型定义规则
        id: "type-def-001",

四、性能优化方案
4.1 缓存策略
// 智能缓存系统
class IntelligentCacheSystem {
  private cache: Map<string, CacheEntry>;
  private readonly maxSize: number;
  
  constructor(maxSize: number = 1000) {
    this.cache = new Map();
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  
  /**
   * 获取缓存结果
   */
  async getOrCompute(key: string, computeFn: () => Promise<any>): Promise<any> {
    // 检查缓存是否存在且未过期
    const cached = this.cache.get(key);
    if (cached && !this.isExpired(cached)) {
      return cached.value;
    
    // 计算新值并缓存
    const value = await computeFn();
    this.set(key, value);
    return value;
  
  /**
   * LRU缓存淘汰策略
   */
  private evictIfNeeded(): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
      // 找到最久未使用的条目
      const lruKey = Array.from(this.cache.entries())
        .sort((a, b) => a[1].lastAccessed - b[1].lastAccessed)[0][0];
      
      this.cache.delete(lruKey);
4.2 并发处理优化
// 并发控制器
class ConcurrencyController {
  private activeTasks: number = 0;
  private readonly maxConcurrent: number;
  private readonly queue: Task[] = [];
  
  constructor(maxConcurrent: number = 5) {
    this.maxConcurrent = maxConcurrent;
  
  /**
   * 执行任务
   */
  async execute<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    if (this.activeTasks >= this.maxConcurrent) {
      // 加入队列等待
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        this.queue.push({ task, resolve, reject });
    
    this.activeTasks++;
      const result = await task();
      return result;
    } finally {
      this.activeTasks--;
      this.processQueue();
  
  /**
   * 处理队列中的任务
   */
  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.queue.length > 0 && this.activeTasks < this.maxConcurrent) {
      const nextTask = this.queue.shift();
      if (nextTask) {
        nextTask.task()
          .then(nextTask.resolve)
          .catch(nextTask.reject)
          .finally(() => {

class AutomatedTestRunner {

  private loadTestCases(): void {
    this.testCases = [

          user_request: "创建一个天气查询插件，输入城市名，返回天气信息",
          request_type: "natural_language"
        validate: (output) => {
          return output.includes('interface PluginInput') &&
                 output.includes('interface PluginOutput') &&
                 output.includes('export async function run');
        name: "JSON错误修复",
          user_request: `{
            "name": "test_plugin",
            "inputParameters": {
              "city": {
                "type": "string",
                "required": true,
              }  // 这里有个多余的逗号
          }`,
          request_type: "error_fix"
          return !output.includes(',]') && // 修复尾随逗号
                 JSON.parse(output); // 确保是有效的JSON
  
  /**
   * 运行所有测试
   */
  async runAllTests(): Promise<TestResults> {
    const results: TestResult[] = [];
    
    for (const testCase of this.testCases) {
      const startTime = Date.now();
      
        const output = await this.executeWorkflow(testCase.input);
        const isValid = testCase.validate(output);
        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
        
        results.push({
          name: testCase.name,
          success: isValid,
          duration,
          error: isValid ? null : "验证失败"
          duration: Date.now() - startTime,
          error: error.message
    
      total: results.length,
      passed: results.filter(r => r.success).length,
      failed: results.filter(r => !r.success).length,
      results
六、部署与监控
6.1 部署配置
# deployment.yaml
apiVersion: coze.cn/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: plugin-auto-generator
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
      containers:
      - name: generator
        image: coze/plugin-generator:latest
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "1Gi"
            cpu: "500m"
        env:
        - name: COZE_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: coze-secrets
              key: apiKey
        - name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
              name: deepseek-secrets
6.2 监控配置
# monitoring.yaml
  enabled: true
  port: 9090
  path: /metrics
  
alerting:
  rules:
  - alert: HighErrorRate
    expr: rate(workflow_errors_total[5m]) > 0.1
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "高错误率警报"
      description: "工作流错误率超过10%"
  
  - alert: SlowResponse
    expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(workflow_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 30
      severity: warning
      summary: "响应时间过长"
      description: "95%的请求响应时间超过30秒"
七、使用指南
7.1 快速开始
# 1. 安装Coze CLI
npm install -g @coze/cli

# 2. 登录认证
coze login

# 3. 部署工作流
coze workflow deploy plugin_auto_workflow.yaml

# 4. 测试工作流
coze workflow test plugin_auto_workflow \
  --input '{"user_request": "创建天气查询插件", "request_type": "natural_language"}'

# 检查工作流状态
coze workflow status plugin_auto_workflow

# 查看日志
coze workflow logs plugin_auto_workflow --tail=100

# 重启工作流
coze workflow restart plugin_auto_workflow

八、总结
Coze 全自动插件开发与修复系统提供了一个完整的解决方案，具备以下特点：

全面自动化：从需求分析到代码生成、错误修复全流程自动化

智能诊断：内置强大的错误诊断和修复能力

高性能：优化缓存策略和并发处理，确保快速响应

易于使用：零基础用户也能快速上手

可靠稳定：完善的监控和告警机制

通过本系统，用户可以：

用自然语言描述需求，自动生成插件代码

自动修复现有的错误代码和配置

获得详细的诊断报告和改进建议

// src/core/workflow-engine.ts
export class CozeWorkflowEngine {
  private workflowRegistry: Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>;
  private executionHistory: ExecutionHistory[];
  private cacheManager: CacheManager;
  
  constructor(private config: EngineConfig) {
    this.workflowRegistry = new Map();
    this.executionHistory = [];
    this.cacheManager = new CacheManager(config.cache);
  
  /**
   * 注册工作流定义
   */
  async registerWorkflow(definition: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<void> {
    // 验证工作流定义
    const validationResult = await this.validateWorkflow(definition);
    if (!validationResult.valid) {
      throw new Error(`工作流验证失败: ${validationResult.errors.join(', ')}`);
    
    this.workflowRegistry.set(definition.id, definition);
    
    // 预编译工作流
    await this.precompileWorkflow(definition);
  
  /**
   * 执行工作流
   */
  async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, input: WorkflowInput): Promise<WorkflowOutput> {
    const executionId = this.generateExecutionId();
    
      const workflow = this.workflowRegistry.get(workflowId);
      if (!workflow) {
        throw new Error(`工作流不存在: ${workflowId}`);
      
      // 检查缓存
      const cacheKey = this.generateCacheKey(workflowId, input);
      const cachedResult = await this.cacheManager.get(cacheKey);
      if (cachedResult) {
        return cachedResult;
      
      // 执行工作流
      const context: ExecutionContext = {
        executionId,
        workflowId,
        input,
        startTime,
        variables: new Map()
      
      const result = await this.executeNode(workflow.startNode, context);
      
      // 缓存结果
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, result, workflow.cacheTtl);
      
      // 记录执行历史
      this.recordExecution({
        output: result,
        status: 'success'
      
      
      // 记录失败执行
        status: 'failed'
      
      throw error;
  
  /**
   * 执行单个节点
   */
  private async executeNode(node: WorkflowNode, context: ExecutionContext): Promise<any> {
    switch (node.type) {
      case 'start':
        return await this.executeStartNode(node, context);
      case 'llm':
        return await this.executeLLMNode(node, context);
      case 'code':
        return await this.executeCodeNode(node, context);
      case 'condition':
        return await this.executeConditionNode(node, context);
      case 'end':
        return await this.executeEndNode(node, context);
      default:
        throw new Error(`未知节点类型: ${node.type}`);

// src/services/llm-integration.service.ts
export class LLMIntegrationService {
  private providers: Map<string, LLMProvider>;
  private rateLimiters: Map<string, RateLimiter>;
  
  constructor(private config: LLMConfig) {
    this.providers = new Map();
    this.rateLimiters = new Map();
    this.initializeProviders();
  
  /**
   * 初始化LLM提供商
   */
  private initializeProviders(): void {
    // DeepSeek-R1 配置
    this.providers.set('deepseek', new DeepSeekProvider({
      apiKey: this.config.deepseekApiKey,
      baseURL: 'https://api.deepseek.com/v1',
      maxRetries: 3
    }));
    
    // 豆包种子配置
    this.providers.set('doubao', new DoubaoProvider({
      apiKey: this.config.doubaoApiKey,
      baseURL: 'https://doubao.cn/api/v1',
    
    // 初始化限流器
    this.rateLimiters.set('deepseek', new TokenBucketRateLimiter(60, 10)); // 60 RPM, burst 10
    this.rateLimiters.set('doubao', new TokenBucketRateLimiter(50, 8)); // 50 RPM, burst 8
  
  /**
   * 生成插件代码
   */
  async generatePluginCode(prompt: string, options: GenerationOptions = {}): Promise<GenerationResult> {
    const provider = this.selectProvider(options.provider);
    const limiter = this.rateLimiters.get(provider.name);
    
    // 等待限流器
    await limiter.acquire();
    
      const systemPrompt = this.buildSystemPrompt(options);
      const userPrompt = this.buildUserPrompt(prompt, options);
      
      const response = await provider.generateCompletion({
        model: options.model || provider.defaultModel,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          { role: 'user', content: userPrompt }
        temperature: options.temperature || 0.7,
        max_tokens: options.maxTokens || 4000,
        top_p: options.topP || 0.9
      
      // 验证和清理响应
      const cleanedCode = this.cleanGeneratedCode(response.content);
      
        code: cleanedCode,
        provider: provider.name,
        model: response.model,
        usage: response.usage,
        warnings: this.validateCode(cleanedCode)
      
      // 失败时尝试备用提供商
      if (options.fallback && this.providers.size > 1) {
        const fallbackProvider = this.selectFallbackProvider(provider.name);
        return this.generatePluginCode(prompt, {
          ...options,
          provider: fallbackProvider.name,
          fallback: false // 防止无限回退
      
      throw new Error(`代码生成失败: ${error.message}`);
  
  /**
   * 构建系统提示词
   */
  private buildSystemPrompt(options: GenerationOptions): string {
    return `你是一个专业的Coze插件开发专家。请严格按照以下要求生成代码：

代码规范要求：
1. 必须是完整的Node.js TypeScript代码
2. 包含PluginInput和PluginOutput接口定义
3. 实现export async function run()
4. 包含完整的错误处理机制
5. 遵循Coze平台最佳实践

输出格式：
- 直接输出可执行代码
- 确保代码格式正确

${options.strict ? '严格模式：如果需求不明确，请要求澄清而不是猜测。' : ''}`;

4. 缓存与性能优化系统
// src/services/performance-optimization.service.ts
export class PerformanceOptimizationService {
  private cache: CacheManager;
  private metrics: PerformanceMetrics;
  private optimizationStrategies: OptimizationStrategy[];
  
  constructor(private config: PerformanceConfig) {
    this.cache = new CacheManager(config.cache);
    this.metrics = new PerformanceMetrics();
    this.optimizationStrategies = this.initializeStrategies();
  
  /**
   * 优化工作流执行
   */
  async optimizeWorkflowExecution(workflowId: string, input: any): Promise<OptimizationResult> {
    const optimizationContext: OptimizationContext = {
      historicalData: await this.getHistoricalData(workflowId),
      currentLoad: await this.getSystemLoad()
    
    // 应用优化策略
    const optimizations: AppliedOptimization[] = [];
    
    for (const strategy of this.optimizationStrategies) {
      if (await strategy.canApply(optimizationContext)) {
        const optimization = await strategy.apply(optimizationContext);
        optimizations.push(optimization);
        
        // 更新优化上下文
        optimizationContext.appliedOptimizations = optimizations;
    
    // 执行优化后的工作流
    const result = await this.executeOptimizedWorkflow(workflowId, input, optimizations);
    
    // 记录性能指标
    await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(workflowId, duration, optimizations);
    
      result,
      optimizations,
      performance: {
        executionTime: duration,
        cacheHits: this.cache.getHitCount(),
        memoryUsage: process.memoryUsage(),
        optimizationImpact: this.calculateOptimizationImpact(optimizations)
  
  /**
   * 智能缓存策略
   */
  private async getCachedResult<T>(key: string, computeFn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    // 检查缓存
    const cached = await this.cache.get<T>(key);
    if (cached) {
      this.metrics.recordCacheHit();
      return cached;
    
    // 计算新值
    const result = await computeFn();
    
    // 确定缓存TTL
    const ttl = this.determineOptimalTTL(key, result);
    
    // 异步缓存结果
    this.cache.set(key, result, ttl).catch(error => {
      console.warn('缓存设置失败:', error);
    
    this.metrics.recordCacheMiss();
  
  /**
   * 确定最优缓存TTL
   */
  private determineOptimalTTL(key: string, value: any): number {
    // 基于数据特性和访问模式确定TTL
    const baseTTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5分钟基础TTL
    
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 10000) {
      return baseTTL * 2; // 大内容缓存更久
    
    if (key.includes('generated_code')) {
      return 10 * 60 * 1000; // 生成的代码缓存10分钟
    
    if (key.includes('diagnosis')) {
      return 2 * 60 * 1000; // 诊断结果缓存2分钟
    
    return baseTTL;

export class MonitoringService {
  private metricsCollector: MetricsCollector;

    this.alertManager = new AlertManager(config.alerts);
    this.logAggregator = new LogAggregator(config.logging);
  
  /**
   * 初始化监控
   */
  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    // 启动指标收集
    await this.metricsCollector.start();

    // 初始化告警规则

    const tags = {

    // 记录执行计数

      'workflow_execution_total',
      1,
    
    // 记录错误率
    if (execution.status === 'failed') {
        'workflow_execution_errors',
    
    // 检查是否触发告警
    await this.checkAlerts(execution);

   */
  private async checkAlerts(execution: WorkflowExecution): Promise<void> {
    const alertRules = await this.alertManager.getRelevantRules(execution);
    
    for (const rule of alertRules) {
      const shouldTrigger = await this.evaluateAlertRule(rule, execution);
      
      if (shouldTrigger) {
        await this.triggerAlert(rule, execution);
  
  /**
   * 获取系统健康状态
   */
  async getSystemHealth(): Promise<SystemHealth> {
    const healthChecks = await Promise.allSettled([
      this.checkDatabaseHealth(),
      this.checkCacheHealth(),
      this.checkLLMHealth(),
      this.checkStorageHealth()
    ]);
    
    const components: HealthComponent[] = healthChecks.map((result, index) => {
      const componentNames = ['database', 'cache', 'llm', 'storage'];
      if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
          name: componentNames[index],
          status: 'healthy',
          details: result.value
      } else {
          status: 'unhealthy',
          error: result.reason.message
    
    const overallStatus = components.every(c => c.status === 'healthy') 
      ? 'healthy' 
      : 'degraded';
    
      status: overallStatus,
      components,
      metrics: await this.getSystemMetrics()

Docker 配置
dockerfile
# Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS base

# 安装依赖
RUN apk add --no-cache \
    python3 \
    make \
    g++ \
    curl

# 设置工作目录
WORKDIR /app

# 复制包文件
COPY package*.json ./
COPY tsconfig.json ./

# 生产阶段
FROM base AS production
RUN npm ci --only=production && npm cache clean --force

# 复制源码
COPY . .

# 构建应用
RUN npm run build

# 设置非root用户
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs
RUN adduser -S nextjs -u 1001

# 更改文件所有权
RUN chown -R nextjs:nodejs /app
USER nextjs

# 暴露端口
EXPOSE 3000

# 健康检查
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1

# 启动应用
CMD ["npm", "start"]

RESTful API 端点
// src/controllers/workflow.controller.ts
@Controller('api/v1/workflows')
export class WorkflowController {
  
  @Post('execute')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async executeWorkflow(
    @Body() request: ExecuteWorkflowRequest
  ): Promise<ExecuteWorkflowResponse> {
    const result = await this.workflowService.execute(
      request.workflowId,
      request.input,
      request.options
    
      data: result,
      executionId: result.executionId,
      duration: result.duration
  
  @Post('generate-code')
  async generateCode(
    @Body() request: GenerateCodeRequest
  ): Promise<GenerateCodeResponse> {
    const generationResult = await this.codeGenerationService.generate(
      request.prompt,
    
      success: generationResult.success,
      code: generationResult.code,
      warnings: generationResult.warnings,
      provider: generationResult.provider,
      usage: generationResult.usage
  
  @Post('diagnose-errors')
  async diagnoseErrors(
    @Body() request: DiagnoseErrorsRequest
  ): Promise<DiagnoseErrorsResponse> {
    const diagnosis = await this.errorDiagnosisService.diagnose(
      request.code,
      request.context
    
    const fixes = request.autoFix 
      ? await this.errorDiagnosisService.autoFix(request.code, diagnosis.diagnostics)
      : null;
    
      diagnosis,
      fixes,
      suggestions: diagnosis.suggestions

// 请求/响应类型定义

完整的错误处理策略
// src/utils/error-handling.ts
export class ComprehensiveErrorHandler {
  private static instance: ComprehensiveErrorHandler;
  private errorHandlers: Map<string, ErrorHandler>;
  private recoveryStrategies: RecoveryStrategy[];
  
  private constructor() {
    this.errorHandlers = new Map();
    this.recoveryStrategies = [];
    this.initializeErrorHandlers();
    this.initializeRecoveryStrategies();
  
  /**
   * 处理错误
   */
  async handleError(error: any, context: ErrorContext): Promise<ErrorHandlingResult> {
    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
    const handler = this.errorHandlers.get(errorType);
    
    if (!handler) {
      return this.handleUnknownError(error, context);
    
      // 执行错误处理
      const handlingResult = await handler.handle(error, context);
      
      // 尝试恢复
      if (handlingResult.recoverable) {
        const recoveryResult = await this.attemptRecovery(error, context, handlingResult);
        return { ...handlingResult, recovery: recoveryResult };
      
      return handlingResult;
      
    } catch (handlingError) {
      // 错误处理本身失败
      return this.handleErrorHandlerFailure(error, handlingError, context);
  
  /**
   * 分类错误类型
   */
  private classifyError(error: any): string {
    if (error.code) {
      return `code_${error.code}`;
    
    if (error.name) {
      return error.name.toLowerCase();
    
    if (error.message) {
      if (error.message.includes('timeout')) return 'timeout_error';
      if (error.message.includes('network')) return 'network_error';
      if (error.message.includes('syntax')) return 'syntax_error';
    
    return 'unknown_error';
  
  /**
   * 尝试恢复
   */
  private async attemptRecovery(
    originalError: any, 
    context: ErrorContext, 
    handlingResult: ErrorHandlingResult
  ): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    for (const strategy of this.recoveryStrategies) {
      if (await strategy.canRecover(originalError, context)) {
          const recoveryResult = await strategy.recover(originalError, context);
          
          if (recoveryResult.success) {
              strategy: strategy.name,
              result: recoveryResult.result,
              attempts: 1
        } catch (recoveryError) {
          console.warn(`恢复策略 ${strategy.name} 失败:`, recoveryError);
    
      strategy: 'none',
      error: 'No recovery strategy succeeded',
      attempts: this.recoveryStrategies.length

一、项目总览
CozePluginAI — 智能插件开发与修复平台

核心目标
完全自动化地完成 Coze 平台插件 的自然语言生成、错误诊断、代码修复、工作流优化及全自动部署，实现从“需求描述”到“可运行插件”的零代码、零配置、极速交付。

核心理念
“输入需求，输出完美解决方案”
“2次点击，30秒内完成”

层级	技术选型
前端	React 18 + TypeScript, Redux Toolkit + RTK Query, Ant Design 5.x, Vite 5.x, TailwindCSS, ECharts + AntV G6

四、核心功能模块详解
4.1 智能需求解析器
输入：自然语言描述（如“创建天气查询插件”）或错误 JSON 代码

处理：LLM 自动提取功能点、输入参数、输出结构

输出：结构化的技术规格清单

4.2 深度诊断引擎
JSON 语法层：检查注释、尾随逗号、引号、括号匹配

Schema 规范层：验证是否符合 Coze 插件 Schema，检查缺失字段、类型错误

工作流结构层：检测孤立节点、无效连线、逻辑死循环

运行环境层：检测 API 密钥、依赖冲突、超时配置

4.3 一键自动化修复中心
自动移除注释、修复引号、添加缺失逗号

智能填充默认值、类型校正、字段增删

自动重新连接断开节点、优化布局

参数优化（超时、分页、重试策略）

4.4 AI 代码生成器
基于 DeepSeek-R1 或 Doubao-Seed 生成完整的 Node.js TypeScript 代码

包含 PluginInput、PluginOutput 接口，run 函数，完整错误处理

同时生成 plugin.json、package.json 等必要文件

4.5 验证与测试执行器
自动生成测试用例，沙盒环境模拟运行

结果对比，验证是否符合预期

4.6 统一报告生成器
输出修复/生成的完整代码包

提供详细报告：错误列表、修复措施、统计信息

系统提示词（严格符合 Coze 规范）：

1. 如果是自然语言需求：解析功能需求，生成完整的Node.js TypeScript代码，包含PluginInput/PluginOutput接口，实现export async function run()，包含完整错误处理。
2. 如果是错误代码：诊断JSON语法错误，修复节点连接，校正参数配置，优化代码结构。
3. 输出要求：直接输出可执行代码，不要包含解释性文字，符合Coze平台规范。
用户提示词：根据以下需求生成Coze插件代码：功能需求：{{user_request}}，测试输入：{{test_input}}，修复模式：{{repair_mode}}。

5.4 结束节点配置
返回文本：{{generated_code}}

流式输出：开启

八、完整 API 端点
  async executeWorkflow(@Body() request: ExecuteWorkflowRequest): Promise<ExecuteWorkflowResponse> {
    const result = await this.workflowService.execute(request.workflowId, request.input, request.options);
    return { success: true, data: result, executionId: result.executionId, duration: result.duration };
  
  async generateCode(@Body() request: GenerateCodeRequest): Promise<GenerateCodeResponse> {
    const result = await this.codeGenerationService.generate(request.prompt, request.options);
    return { success: result.success, code: result.code, warnings: result.warnings, provider: result.provider, usage: result.usage };
  
  async diagnoseErrors(@Body() request: DiagnoseErrorsRequest): Promise<DiagnoseErrorsResponse> {
    const diagnosis = await this.errorDiagnosisService.diagnose(request.code, request.context);
    const fixes = request.autoFix ? await this.errorDiagnosisService.autoFix(request.code, diagnosis.diagnostics) : null;
    return { diagnosis, fixes, suggestions: diagnosis.suggestions };

  options?: { cache?: boolean; timeout?: number; priority?: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' };

完整功能需求：无需手动配置，只需一个按钮，自动修复所有问题（节点连接、参数错误、运行环境）。

自动化修复流程：智能诊断 → 一键修复 → 验证结果。

支持修复类型：JSON语法修复、节点连接修复、模式错误修复、工作流修复。

验证结果：自动运行测试用例、生成修复报告、确认工作流正常

场景2：参数错误 → 自动识别参数缺失 → 智能填充合理值 → 保持参数合规性

蓝色框 4：全自动诊断系统架构
系统架构：

自动探路机器人：连接性自检 → 参数压力测试 → 错误捕获与分类

诊断报告与一键修复：生成极简报告（错误节点、错误类型、建议修复）→ 点击“自动应用修复”按钮 → 系统自动填充正确参数并重新测试

极速体验：输入需求 → 点击“自动诊断” → 节点高亮闪烁 → 弹出报告 → 点击“一键修复” → 完成

蓝色框 5：JSON修复与格式化工具
核心功能：

格式兼容：将任何格式混乱或错误的输入转换为符合 Coze 平台标准的 JSON 代码

错误修复：自动识别并修复 JSON 代码中的语法错误、结构错误、字段缺失

节点健全性检查：确保插件定义内部的逻辑节点连接正确、结构完整

支持修复类型：JSON语法修复（移除注释、修复引号、修复尾随逗号、修复未加引号的键名）→ 节点连接修复（移除指向不存在节点的连接、验证所有连接的有效性）→ 模式错误修复（确保必需字段存在、修复字段类型错误、添加缺失的默认值）

蓝色框 6：输入参数配置
coze_json_inputs: 需要修复的 JSON 代码
repair_mode: 修复模式（basic, comprehensive, thorough, aggressive）
output_structure: 输出结构（single_merged, plugin_array, individual_files, coze_import_ready）
naming_convention: 命名约定（snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, original）
auto_connect_nodes: 是否自动连接节点（默认 true）
validate_schema: 是否验证模式（默认 true）
repair_workflow: 是否修复工作流（默认 true）
fix_node_connections: 是否修复节点连接（默认 true）

蓝色框 7：测试与验证方案
功能测试：提供各种Coze问题描述，验证解析准确性 → 测试不同修复深度选项的效果 → 模拟不同错误场景 → 检查输出格式
性能测试：测试节点处理大规模工作流的能力 → 验证不同修复深度选项的响应时间 → 检查资源使用情况
兼容性测试：测试节点与不同版本Coze平台的兼容性 → 验证节点处理各种类型插件和工作流的能力

蓝色框 8：部署与维护
部署流程：在Coze平台创建工作流 → 配置开始节点接收用户输入 → 添加万能输入处理器节点并配置参数 → 设置结束节点返回处理结果 → 测试工作流功能完整性 → 发布工作流供用户使用
维护计划：定期更新规则库 → 监控节点性能 → 收集用户反馈 → 建立问题追踪机制

蓝色框 9：工作流结构定义
开始节点：接收用户输入 → 参数（user_request字符串、auto_execute布尔值可选、repair_depth字符串可选）
中间处理节点（万能输入处理器）：解析用户请求 → 识别问题类型和范围 → 扫描工作流环境 → 检测所有相关问题 → 确定修复策略 → 执行修复操作 → 生成处理报告
结束节点：返回处理结果 → 输出参数（processed_request、detected_issues、actions_taken、result_status、summary）

蓝色框 10：LLM完整解释
“LLM完整”的含义：利用大语言模型（LLM）实现端到端的、无需人工干预的自动化解决方案。以LLM节点为核心大脑，自动理解需求、诊断和修复Coze插件与工作流的各种错误，从零开始生成符合规范的代码，实现“输入描述，输出成品”的终极目标。

三大核心能力：自然语言理解（NLU）、代码生成与修复、逻辑推理与结构化输出。

蓝色框 11：零基础操作流程
第一步：创建插件 → 进入Coze工作台，点击“插件”→“创建插件”→ 选择“在Coze IDE中创建”→ 运行时选择Node.js
第二步：使用AI生成代码 → 复制AI指令模板，发送给DeepSeek或类似AI工具
第三步：测试与发布 → 粘贴代码 → 调试 → 发布

给零基础朋友的总结：不要怕代码（它只是固定结构的要求清单）→ 你的角色是“产品经理”（清晰定义功能、输入、输出）→ AI是你的“程序员”→ Coze是“工厂和仓库”

/**
 * 令牌桶限流器
 */
class TokenBucketRateLimiter {
  private tokens: number;
  private lastRefill: number;

  constructor(private rate: number, private burst: number) {
    this.tokens = burst;
    this.lastRefill = Date.now();

  async acquire(): Promise<void> {
    this.refill();
    if (this.tokens < 1) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000 / this.rate));
      return this.acquire();
    this.tokens--;

  private refill(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    const elapsed = (now - this.lastRefill) / 1000;
    const refillAmount = elapsed * this.rate;
    this.tokens = Math.min(this.burst, this.tokens + refillAmount);
    this.lastRefill = now;

  async fix(code: string, diagnostic: CodeDiagnostic): Promise<FixResult> {

    fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '');

    // 修复尾随逗号
    fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/,(\s*[}\]])/g, '$1');

    // 修复未加引号的键名
    fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*:/g, '$1"$2":');

    // 修复单引号为双引号
    fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/'/g, '"');

      original,
      fixed,
      fixedCode

version: '3.8'

services:
  app:
    build: .
    container_name: coze-plugin-ai
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@postgres:5432/coze_plugin

      - DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}

      - redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./logs:/app/logs

  postgres:
    image: postgres:14-alpine
    container_name: coze-postgres
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password
      - POSTGRES_DB=coze_plugin
      - "5432:5432"
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: coze-redis
      - "6379:6379"
      - redis_data:/data

    container_name: coze-prometheus
      - "9090:9090"

class TimeoutErrorHandler implements ErrorHandler {
  async handle(error: any, context: ErrorContext): Promise<ErrorHandlingResult> {
      recoverable: true,

/**
 * 重试恢复策略
 */
class RetryRecoveryStrategy implements RecoveryStrategy {
  name: string = 'RetryRecovery';
  private maxRetries: number = 3;

  async canRecover(error: any, context: ErrorContext): Promise<boolean> {
    return context.retryCount < this.maxRetries;

  async recover(error: any, context: ErrorContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    context.retryCount = (context.retryCount || 0) + 1;
    const delay = context.retryCount * 1000;
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
    
      strategy: this.name,
      result: { retryCount: context.retryCount }

// 2. 核心类型定义
// ==========================================
export type TaskType = 
  | "neural_decision"
  | "data_processing"
  | "content_creation"
  | "workflow_management"
  | "plugin_generation"
  | "github_integration"
  | "error_diagnosis"
  | "luoyang_heritage"
  | "plugin_fix"
  | "workflow_fix"
  | "api_plugin_create"
  | "unknown";

export interface SuperAutomationInput {
  userInput: string;
  taskType?: TaskType;
  attachments?: string[];
  config?: {
    platform?: "douyin" | "feishu" | "luoyang-erp";
    outputFormat?: "json" | "pdf" | "video";
    debug?: boolean;
    bypassEmptyCache?: boolean;
    fixMode?: "params" | "code" | "all";

export interface SuperAutomationOutput {
  processResult: {
    taskType: TaskType;
    executionTime: number;
  data?: {
    resultContent?: string;
    fileUrls?: string[];
    workflowId?: string;
    nodeCount?: number;
    errorFixDetails?: string[];
    pluginId?: string;
    fixedFields?: string[];
    openApiSpec?: any;
    [key: string]: any;
  error?: {
    code: number;
    fixSuggestion: string;

// ==========================================
// 3. 主类与核心逻辑实现
// ==========================================
export class SuperAutomationHub extends CozeTool<SuperAutomationInput, SuperAutomationOutput> {
  private nlpService: NLPService;
  private codeRepoService: CodeRepositoryService;
  private httpService: HttpService;
  private cryptoService: CryptoService;
  private cacheService: CacheService;
  private fileService: FileService;
  private workflowService: WorkflowService;
  private pluginService: PluginService;
  private executionLog: string[] = [];

    super(PluginMeta);
    this.nlpService = new NLPService();
    this.codeRepoService = new CodeRepositoryService();
    this.httpService = new HttpService();
    this.cryptoService = new CryptoService();
    this.cacheService = new CacheService();
    this.fileService = new FileService();
    this.workflowService = new WorkflowService();
    this.pluginService = new PluginService();
    
    this.initNlpTraining();

  private async initNlpTraining() {
    const trainingData = [
      { text: "控制机械臂搬运零件", intent: "neural_decision" },
      { text: "分析销售数据并生成图表", intent: "data_processing" },
      { text: "生成汉服推广视频", intent: "content_creation" },
      { text: "创建客户咨询工作流", intent: "workflow_management" },
      { text: "生成抖音文案提取插件", intent: "plugin_generation" },
      { text: "导入GitHub仓库并部署", intent: "github_integration" },
      { text: "修复[101006]错误", intent: "error_diagnosis" },
      { text: "生成唐三彩工艺视频", intent: "luoyang_heritage" },
      { text: "修复插件 plugin-123", intent: "plugin_fix" },
      { text: "修复工作流 wf-456", intent: "workflow_fix" },
      { text: "创建天气插件 https://api.weather.com/data GET", intent: "api_plugin_create" }
    
    for (const item of trainingData) {
      await this.nlpService.addTrainingData({
        text: item.text,
        intent: item.intent,
        language: 'zh'
    await this.nlpService.train();

  async handle(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput> {
    const cacheKey = this.generateCacheKey(input);
    
      // 参数验证（解决Invalid params错误）
      if (!input.userInput || typeof input.userInput !== 'string') {
        throw {
          code: 10010,
          message: "无效输入参数：userInput 必须为字符串",
          fixSuggestion: "提供有效的自然语言描述"

      // 检查缓存（如启用）
      if (input.config?.cache) {
        const cachedResult = await this.cacheService.get<SuperAutomationOutput>(cacheKey);
        if (cachedResult && (!input.config?.bypassEmptyCache || 
            (cachedResult.data && Object.keys(cachedResult.data).length > 0))) {
          this.executionLog.push("命中缓存，返回缓存结果");
            ...cachedResult,
              ...cachedResult.processResult,
              executionTime: Date.now() - startTime

      // 1. 自动识别任务类型（未指定时）
      let { taskType } = input;
      if (!taskType) {
        const nlpResult = await this.nlpService.process({
          text: input.userInput,
        taskType = nlpResult.intent as TaskType;
            code: 10001,
            message: "无法识别任务类型，请补充细节",
            fixSuggestion: "示例：生成洛阳汉服推广视频/分析近3个月销售数据"
      this.executionLog.push(`识别任务类型：${taskType}`);

      // 2. 任务分发（映射至对应处理模块）
      const taskHandlers: Record<TaskType, () => Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']>> = {
        neural_decision: () => this.handleNeuralDecision(input),
        data_processing: () => this.handleDataProcessing(input),
        content_creation: () => this.handleContentCreation(input),
        workflow_management: () => this.handleWorkflowManagement(input),
        plugin_generation: () => this.handlePluginGeneration(input),
        github_integration: () => this.handleGitHubIntegration(input),
        error_diagnosis: () => this.handleErrorDiagnosis(input),
        luoyang_heritage: () => this.handleLuoyangHeritage(input),
        plugin_fix: () => this.fixPlugin(input),
        workflow_fix: () => this.fixWorkflow(input),
        api_plugin_create: () => this.createApiPlugin(input),
        unknown: () => this.handleUnknownTask(input)

      const handler = taskHandlers[taskType];
          code: 10002,
          message: `不支持的任务类型：${taskType}`,
          fixSuggestion: "支持的类型：neural_decision、data_processing等（见TaskType定义）"

      // 3. 执行任务并返回结果
      const resultData = await handler();
      const finalResult: SuperAutomationOutput = {
          taskType,
        data: { ...resultData, executionLog: input.config?.debug ? this.executionLog : undefined }

      // 存入缓存（如启用）
        await this.cacheService.set(cacheKey, finalResult, 1800); // 默认缓存30分钟

      return finalResult;

    } catch (error: any) {
      // 统一错误处理
      const errorInfo = error.code ? error : {
        code: 10000,
        message: error.message || "未知错误",
        fixSuggestion: "检查输入参数或网络连接"
          taskType: input.taskType || "unknown",
        data: {},
        error: errorInfo

  /** 处理未知任务类型 */
  private async handleUnknownTask(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
      resultContent: "任务类型无法识别，请提供更多上下文信息",
      suggestion: "请明确说明需要执行的操作类型，例如：数据分析、内容创作或设备控制等"

  /** 生成缓存键 */
  private generateCacheKey(input: SuperAutomationInput): string {
    const keyData = {
      userInput: input.userInput,
      taskType: input.taskType,
      attachments: input.attachments?.join(','),
      platform: input.config?.platform,
      fixMode: input.config?.fixMode
    return this.cryptoService.hash(JSON.stringify(keyData), 'md5');

  // ==========================================
  // 4. 功能模块实现（修复引用一致性）
  // ==========================================

  /** 4.1 神经意识决策模块（设备控制与自主决策） */
  private async handleNeuralDecision(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入神经意识决策模块");
    
    // 解析设备信息与任务需求
    const entityResult = await this.nlpService.extractEntities(input.userInput);
    const deviceEntity = entityResult.entities.find(e => e.type === 'device');
    const taskEntity = entityResult.entities.find(e => e.type === 'task');
    
    if (!deviceEntity || !taskEntity) {
        code: 10101,
        message: "未识别到设备类型或任务指令",
        fixSuggestion: "示例：控制机械臂搬运8kg零件/调控唐三彩窑炉温度"
    const deviceType = deviceEntity.value;
    const task = taskEntity.value;

    // 设备能力校验
    const deviceCapabilities = {
      "机械臂": { maxWeight: 10, power: 80 },
      "窑炉": { maxTemp: 1300, duration: 480 },
      "刺绣机": { speed: 500, materials: ["丝绸", "棉布"] }
    let decision = "执行任务";
    let reason = "";
    let actionCommands: any = {};

    // 任务可行性判断与指令生成
    if (deviceType === "机械臂" && task.includes("搬运")) {
      const weightMatch = task.match(/\d+/);
      if (!weightMatch) throw new Error("未指定搬运重量");
      const weight = parseInt(weightMatch[0]);
      
      if (weight > (deviceCapabilities as any).机械臂.maxWeight) {
        decision = "拒绝任务";
        reason = `设备最大承重${(deviceCapabilities as any).机械臂.maxWeight}kg，任务需求${weight}kg`;
        actionCommands = {
          speed: input.userInput.includes("安全") ? 0.5 : 1.0,
          path: "最优路径规划",
          gripForce: weight > 5 ? "高" : "中",
          estimatedTime: `${Math.random() * 10 + 5}秒`
    } else if (deviceType === "窑炉" && task.includes("烧制")) {
        temp: 1200,
        stages: ["预热30分钟", "高温烧制2小时", "冷却1小时"],
        material: "二次施釉唐三彩"

      resultContent: `设备${deviceType}${decision}：${reason || "指令已生成"}`,
      deviceStatus: {
        type: deviceType,
        capabilities: (deviceCapabilities as any)[deviceType],
        power: (deviceCapabilities as any)[deviceType].power || 100
      actionCommands: decision === "执行任务" ? actionCommands : undefined

  /** 4.2 全维度数据处理模块（多源整合与可视化） */
  private async handleDataProcessing(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入数据处理模块");
    
    // 解析数据需求与来源
    const dataSource = input.attachments?.[0] || "模拟数据";
    const operationType = input.userInput.includes("分析") ? "分析" 
      : input.userInput.includes("转换") ? "转换" 
      : input.userInput.includes("可视化") ? "可视化" 
      : "清洗";

    // 获取数据
    let rawData: any[] = [];
    if (dataSource.startsWith("http") && !dataSource.includes("模拟")) {
      const fileContent = await this.fileService.read({ url: dataSource });
      rawData = JSON.parse(fileContent.toString());
      // 生成模拟数据
      if (input.userInput.includes("销售")) {
        rawData = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => ({
          month: `2024-${i + 1}`,
          category: i % 2 === 0 ? "唐制汉服" : "宋制汉服",
          sales: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000) + 500,
          region: ["洛阳本地", "全国", "跨境"][i % 3]
        rawData = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({
          id: i + 1,
          value: Math.random() * 100,
          timestamp: new Date(2024, 0, i + 1).toISOString()

    // 数据处理逻辑
    let processedResult: any;
    let fileUrls: string[] = [];

    if (operationType === "可视化") {
      const chartType = input.userInput.includes("折线图") ? "line" 
        : input.userInput.includes("柱状图") ? "bar" 
        : "pie";
      
      const chartData = {
        type: chartType,
        data: rawData,
        title: input.userInput
      const chartUrl = await this.fileService.write({
        content: JSON.stringify(chartData),
        format: "json",
        category: "chart"
      
      fileUrls = [chartUrl];
      processedResult = {
        chartType,
        dataPoints: rawData.length,
        description: input.userInput.includes("销售") 
          ? "汉服销售趋势：唐制汉服Q2增长显著" 
          : "数据分布符合预期规律"
    } else if (operationType === "转换") {
      const targetFormat = input.config?.outputFormat || "csv";
      const convertedContent = await this.fileService.convert({
        content: JSON.stringify(rawData),
        fromFormat: "json",
        toFormat: targetFormat
      
      const fileUrl = await this.fileService.write({
        content: convertedContent,
        format: targetFormat,
        category: "data"
      fileUrls = [fileUrl];
      
        sourceFormat: "json",
        targetFormat,
        recordCount: rawData.length,
        convertTime: `${Math.random() * 100}ms`
    } else if (operationType === "分析") {
      const totalSales = rawData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.sales || 0), 0);
      const topCategory = rawData.reduce((top, item) => 
        (item.sales > (top.sales || 0) ? item : top), rawData[0]);
      
        total: totalSales,
        topCategory: topCategory.category,
        trend: totalSales > 5000 ? "上升" : "平稳",
        suggestion: input.userInput.includes("洛阳") 
          ? "增加洛阳本地非遗联名款推广" 
          : "保持现有品类库存水平"

      resultContent: `数据${operationType}完成（${rawData.length}条记录）`,
      processingType: operationType,
      result: processedResult,
      fileUrls

  /** 4.3 跨平台内容创作模块（视频/图文/文案） */
  private async handleContentCreation(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入内容创作模块");
    
    const classification = await this.nlpService.classifyText({
      categories: ['video', 'image', 'text', 'mixed']
    const contentTypes = classification.topCategory as string;

    const scene = input.userInput.includes("电商") ? "ecommerce"
      : input.userInput.includes("非遗") ? "heritage"
      : input.userInput.includes("洛阳") ? "luoyang_local"
      : "general";

    let resultContent: string = "";

    if (contentTypes === "video") {
      const duration = input.userInput.includes("分钟") 
        ? parseInt((input.userInput.match(/(\d+)分钟/) || [])[1] || "1")
        : 1;
      
      const script = scene === "luoyang_local" 
        ? `【洛阳方言开场】中！今天带大家看唐三彩开窑全过程...\n1. 二次施釉细节\n2. 匠人工艺展示\n3. 收藏价值解析`
        : `主题：${input.userInput}\n1. 核心卖点介绍\n2. 使用场景演示\n3. 行动号召`;
      
      const videoScriptUrl = await this.fileService.write({
        content: script,
        format: "txt",
        category: "video_script"
      
      const videoUrl = `https://coze-video.example.com/${Date.now()}.mp4`;
      fileUrls = [videoUrl, videoScriptUrl];
      resultContent = `视频生成完成（${duration}分钟），脚本：${script.substring(0, 50)}...`;
    } else if (contentTypes === "text") {
      const platform = input.config?.platform || "general";
      resultContent = platform === "douyin"
        ? `🔥${input.userInput}！\n3个你不知道的秘密...\n#热门话题 #干货分享\n👇点击查看详情`
        : scene === "heritage"
          ? `【非遗工艺解析】${input.userInput}\n工艺步骤：\n1. 选材（洛阳本地高岭土）\n2. 成型（手工拉坯）\n3. 烧制（1200℃高温）\n传承意义：...`
          : `专业分析：${input.userInput}\n核心观点：\n1. ...\n2. ...\n3. ...`;
      
      if (resultContent.length > 200) {
        const textUrl = await this.fileService.write({
          content: resultContent,
          category: "text_content"
        fileUrls = [textUrl];
    } else if (contentTypes === "image") {
      const imageType = input.userInput.includes("海报") ? "poster" : "infochart";
      const imageDesc = `类型：${imageType}，内容：${input.userInput}，场景：${scene}`;
      
      const imageUrl = await this.fileService.write({
        content: imageDesc,
        category: "image_desc"
      
      fileUrls = [imageUrl];
      resultContent = `${imageType === "poster" ? "海报" : "信息图"}生成完成，包含元素：${input.userInput}`;

      resultContent,
      contentType: contentTypes,
      scene,

  /** 4.4 工作流全生命周期管理模块（含JSON导入与修复） */
  private async handleWorkflowManagement(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入工作流管理模块");
    
    let workflowData: any;
    let isImport = false;

    if (input.attachments?.[0]?.includes(".json") || input.userInput.includes("JSON")) {
      isImport = true;
      const jsonInput = input.attachments?.[0] ? 
        await this.fileService.read({ url: input.attachments[0] }) : 
        input.userInput;
      
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonInput.toString());
        workflowData = parsed.nodes && parsed.edges 
          ? parsed 
          : parsed.json?.nodes ? parsed.json : null;
        
        if (!workflowData || !workflowData.nodes || !workflowData.edges) {
          throw new Error("JSON格式错误：缺少nodes或edges字段");
      } catch (e) {
          code: 10401,
          message: "工作流JSON解析失败",
          fixSuggestion: "确保JSON包含nodes（节点数组）和edges（连接数组）字段，使用在线工具验证格式"

      // 自动修复工作流错误
      const fixDetails = this.fixWorkflowErrors(workflowData);
      this.executionLog.push(`工作流修复完成：${fixDetails.length}个问题`);
      const demandAnalysis = this.analyzeWorkflowDemand(input.userInput);
      workflowData = this.generateWorkflowFromDemand(demandAnalysis);

    // 修复工作流中的插件节点
    if (workflowData.nodes) {
      workflowData.nodes = await Promise.all(workflowData.nodes.map(async (node: any) => {
        if (node.type === "plugin" && node.pluginConfig?.code) {
          return await this.fixWorkflowPluginNode(node);
        return node;
    
    const workflowId = `wf_${Date.now()}`;
    this.executionLog.push(`工作流${isImport ? "导入" : "生成"}成功，ID：${workflowId}`);

      nodeCount: workflowData.nodes.length,
      edgeCount: workflowData.edges.length,
      isImport,
      editUrl: `https://coze.com/workflow/edit/${workflowId}`,
      errorFixDetails: isImport ? this.fixWorkflowErrors(workflowData) : undefined

  /** 工作流错误自动修复 */
  private fixWorkflowErrors(workflow: any): string[] {
    const fixDetails: string[] = [];
    const nodeMap = workflow.nodes.reduce((map: any, node: any) => {
      map[node.id] = node;
      return map;
    }, {});

    // 1. 修复节点类型错误
    workflow.nodes.forEach((node: any, index: number) => {
      if (node.type === "plugin" && !node.pluginId) {
        workflow.nodes[index].type = "input";
        fixDetails.push(`节点${node.id}：修复无效插件节点，替换为输入节点`);
      // 2. 修复[101006]错误
      if (node.type === "plugin" && node.pluginConfig?.code && 
          !node.pluginConfig.code.includes("export const handler")) {
        node.pluginConfig.code += `\n// 自动修复[101006]错误：补充handler导出
export const handler = async (event) => {
  const tool = new AutoFixPlugin();
  return tool.process(event.inputs);
};`;
        fixDetails.push(`节点${node.id}：修复[101006]错误，补充handler函数导出`);

    // 3. 修复连接错误
    workflow.edges = workflow.edges.filter((edge: any) => {
      if (!nodeMap[edge.sourceNodeID] || !nodeMap[edge.targetNodeID]) {
        fixDetails.push(`移除无效连接：${edge.sourceNodeID}→${edge.targetNodeID}`);

    return fixDetails;

  /** 从自然语言需求生成工作流结构 */
  private generateWorkflowFromDemand(demand: any): any {
    const nodes = [
      { id: "n1", type: "input", name: "接收咨询", variables: [{ key: "user_question" }] },
      { id: "n2", type: "llm", name: "意图识别", config: { model: "gpt-4" } },
      { id: "n3", type: "plugin", name: "查询知识库", pluginId: "knowledge_base" },
      { id: "n4", type: "output", name: "生成回复", variables: [{ key: "reply_content" }] }
    const edges = [
      { sourceNodeID: "n1", targetNodeID: "n2" },
      { sourceNodeID: "n2", targetNodeID: "n3" },
      { sourceNodeID: "n3", targetNodeID: "n4" }
    return { nodes, edges };

  /** 解析工作流需求 */
  private analyzeWorkflowDemand(input: string): any {
      steps: input.split("→").map(step => step.trim()),
      isNeedLLM: input.includes("识别") || input.includes("生成"),
      isNeedPlugin: input.includes("查询") || input.includes("调用")

  /** 4.5 插件/代码生成模块（自动修复语法错误） */
  private async handlePluginGeneration(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入插件生成模块");
    
    const entities = await this.nlpService.extractEntities(input.userInput);
    const pluginNameEntity = entities.find(e => e.type === 'plugin_name');
    
    const pluginName = pluginNameEntity?.value 
      ? pluginNameEntity.value.replace(/\s+/g, "_").toLowerCase() 
      : `auto_plugin_${Date.now()}`;
    
    const functionDesc = input.userInput.includes("功能：") 
      ? input.userInput.split("功能：")[1].trim() 
      : input.userInput;

    const pluginCode = `import { CozeTool, ToolMetadata, InputParameter, ToolResult } from '@coze/toolkit';

export const metadata: ToolMetadata = {
  name: '${pluginName}',
  description: '${functionDesc}',
  author: 'Coze Automation',
  requiredPermissions: ['network']

const inputParameters: InputParameter[] = [
    name: 'input_data',
    type: 'string',
    description: '输入数据'

export class ${this.capitalize(pluginName)} extends CozeTool {
    super(metadata, inputParameters);

  async process(params: { [key: string]: any }): Promise<ToolResult> {
      const input = params.input_data;
      const result = this.processInput(input);
        outputs: { result }
        outputs: { error: error.message }

  private processInput(input: string): string {
    return \`处理"\${input}"的结果（功能：${functionDesc}）\`;

export const handler = async (event: any): Promise<ToolResult> => {
  const tool = new ${this.capitalize(pluginName)}();

    const fixedCode = this.fixCodeSyntax(pluginCode);
    const codeUrl = await this.fileService.write({
      content: fixedCode,
      format: "ts",
      category: "plugin_code"

      resultContent: `插件生成完成：${pluginName}`,
      pluginName,
      codeSnippet: fixedCode.substring(0, 300) + "...",
      fileUrls: [codeUrl],
      testResult: {
        status: "passed",
        message: "基础功能测试通过（含[101006]错误检测）"

  /** 辅助函数：首字母大写 */
  private capitalize(str: string): string {
    return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);

  /** 代码语法自动修复 */
  private fixCodeSyntax(code: string): string {
    let fixed = code;
    fixed = fixed.replace(/(\n\s*})/g, ";\n$1");
    const openBraceCount = (fixed.match(/{/g) || []).length;
    const closeBraceCount = (fixed.match(/}/g) || []).length;
    if (openBraceCount > closeBraceCount) {
      fixed += "\n}".repeat(openBraceCount - closeBraceCount);
    return fixed;

  /** 4.6 错误诊断与修复模块（重点解决[101006]） */
  private async handleErrorDiagnosis(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    this.executionLog.push("进入错误诊断修复模块");
    
    const errorInput = input.userInput;
    let errorType: string, diagnosis: string, fixSteps: string[];

    if (errorInput.includes("[101006]") || errorInput.includes("handler函数")) {
      errorType = "Coze平台函数导出错误";
      diagnosis = "未正确导出名为'handler'的入口函数，或函数命名冲突/参数错误";
      fixSteps = [
        "确保代码末尾包含标准导出：export const handler = async (event) => { ... }",
        "检查handler函数是否唯一，避免与其他函数重名",
        "验证函数参数：必须接收event对象，返回ToolResult类型",
        "示例修复代码：export const handler = async (event) => {\n  const tool = new YourPlugin();\n  return tool.process(event.inputs);\n}"

  /** 5.1 插件修复功能（解决Invalid params错误） */
  private async fixPlugin(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    const pluginId = this.extractPluginId(input.userInput);
    if (!pluginId) throw new Error("未提供插件ID");
    
    const pluginDef = await this.pluginService.getDefinition(pluginId);
    const diagnostics = this.diagnosePlugin(pluginDef);
    const fixedPlugin = this.applyPluginFixes(pluginDef, diagnostics);
    await this.pluginService.update(pluginId, fixedPlugin);
    
      message: `插件 ${pluginId} 修复完成`,
      pluginId,
      fixedFields: diagnostics.issues
  
  private extractPluginId(command: string): string | null {
    const match = command.match(/(plugin-[\w\d]+)/);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  
  private diagnosePlugin(plugin: any) {
    const issues = [];
    
    if (!plugin.name || plugin.name.length < 3) issues.push("名称不完整");
    if (!plugin.description || plugin.description.length < 10) issues.push("描述不完整");
    
    if (!plugin.inputParameters || plugin.inputParameters.length === 0) {
      issues.push("缺少输入参数");
      plugin.inputParameters.forEach((param: any, index: number) => {
        if (!param.name) issues.push(`参数${index+1}缺少名称`);
        if (!param.type) issues.push(`参数${param.name || index+1}缺少类型`);
        if (param.required === undefined) issues.push(`参数${param.name || index+1}缺少必填声明`);
    
    return { issues };
  
  private applyPluginFixes(plugin: any, diagnostics: any) {
    const fixedPlugin = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plugin));
    
    if (diagnostics.issues.includes("名称不完整")) {
      fixedPlugin.name = fixedPlugin.name || "修复的插件";
    
    if (diagnostics.issues.includes("描述不完整")) {
      fixedPlugin.description = fixedPlugin.description || "自动修复的插件";
    
    if (diagnostics.issues.includes("缺少输入参数")) {
      fixedPlugin.inputParameters = [
          name: "input",
          description: "输入数据",
      fixedPlugin.inputParameters = fixedPlugin.inputParameters.map((param: any) => {
        if (!param.name) param.name = `param_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
        if (!param.type) param.type = "string";
        if (param.required === undefined) param.required = true;
        return param;
    
    return fixedPlugin;

  /** 5.2 工作流修复功能 */
  private async fixWorkflow(input: SuperAutomationInput): Promise<SuperAutomationOutput['data']> {
    const workflowId = this.extractWorkflowId(input.userInput);
    if (!workflowId) throw new Error("未提供工作流ID");
    
    const workflowDef = await this.workflowService.getDefinition(workflowId);
    const diagnostics = this.diagnoseWorkflow(workflowDef);
    const fixedWorkflow = this.applyWorkflowFixes(workflowDef, diagnostics);
    await this.workflowService.update(workflowId, fixedWorkflow);
    
      message: `工作流 ${workflowId} 修复完成`,
      fixedIssues: diagnostics.issues
  
  private extractWorkflowId(command: string): string | null {
    const match = command.match(/(wf-[\w\d]+)/);
  
  private diagnoseWorkflow(workflow: any) {
    const nodeIds = new Set(workflow.nodes.map((n: any) => n.id));
    
    for (const conn of workflow.connections) {
      if (!nodeIds.has(conn.sourceId)) issues.push(`无效源节点: ${conn.sourceId}`);
      if (!nodeIds.has(conn.targetId)) issues.push(`无效目标节点: ${conn.targetId}`);
    
    workflow.nodes.forEach((node: any) => {
      if (!node.name) issues.push(`节点${node.id}缺少名称`);
      if (!node.type) issues.push(`节点${node.id}缺少类型`);
        issues.push(`插件节点${node.id}缺少pluginId`);
    
  
  private applyWorkflowFixes(workflow: any, diagnostics: any) {
    const fixedWorkflow = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(workflow));
    
    fixedWorkflow.connections = fixedWorkflow.connections.filter((conn: any) => {
      return !diagnostics.issues.includes(`无效源节点: ${conn.sourceId}`) &&
             !diagnostics.issues.includes(`无效目标节点: ${conn.targetId}`);
    
    fixedWorkflow.nodes = fixedWorkflow.nodes.map((node: any) => {
      if (!node.name) node.name = `节点_${node.id.substring(0, 5)}`;
      if (!node.type) node.type = "action";
        node.pluginId = "default-plugin";
    
    return fixedWorkflow;

"""

╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

功能模式 (mode) 路由表：
    diagnose_only   → 诊断空间内所有工作流，输出健康报告
    auto_fix        → 自动修复可修复问题（超时、缺失字段、未发布），生成审计报告
    generate        → 根据自然语言调用生成器 Bot，输出工作流 JSON
    full_auto       → 诊断 → 修复 → 可选生成（全自动闭环）

    content_process → 智能内容处理（代码修复、视频处理、思维导图、格式转换等）

可选环境变量：

import os
import json
import re
import time
import hashlib
import logging
import traceback
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional

import requests

# ---------------------------- 日志配置 ---------------------------------
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='[%(levelname)s] %(message)s')
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# ---------------------------- 环境变量 ---------------------------------
PAT = os.environ.get("COZE_PAT", "")
SPACE_ID = os.environ.get("COZE_SPACE_ID", "")
GENERATOR_BOT_ID = os.environ.get("WORKFLOW_GENERATOR_BOT_ID", "")
OPENAI_API_KEY = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
OPENAI_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")

COZE_API_BASE = "https://api.coze.cn"

# ---------------------------- 辅助函数 ---------------------------------
def make_headers(pat: str = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """构造 Coze API 请求头"""
    token = pat or PAT
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"

def ensure_temp_dir():
    """确保 /temp 目录存在"""
    os.makedirs("/temp", exist_ok=True)

def safe_json_loads(text: str) -> Any:
    """安全地从文本中提取 JSON（支持 markdown 代码块）"""
    text = text.strip()
    # 尝试直接解析
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except:
        pass
    # 提取 ```json ... ``` 块
    match = re.search(r'```json\s*(.*?)\s*```', text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return json.loads(match.group(1))
    # 提取 ``` ... ``` 块
    match = re.search(r'```\s*(.*?)\s*```', text, re.DOTALL)
    raise ValueError("无法从响应中提取 JSON")

# ======================= 1. 工作流诊断模块 ============================
def fetch_all_workflows(space_id: str, headers: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
    """获取空间内所有工作流列表"""
    url = f"{COZE_API_BASE}/v1/workspaces/{space_id}/workflows"
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    if data.get("code") != 0:
        raise Exception(f"API错误: {data.get('msg')}")
    workflows = data.get("data", {}).get("workflows", [])
    logger.info(f"获取到 {len(workflows)} 个工作流")
    return workflows

def fetch_workflow_detail(workflow_id: str, headers: Dict) -> Dict:
    """获取工作流详细定义"""
    url = f"{COZE_API_BASE}/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}"
        raise Exception(f"获取详情失败: {data.get('msg')}")
    return data.get("data", {})

def diagnose_single_workflow(workflow_id: str, workflow_name: str, definition: Dict) -> Dict:
    诊断单个工作流，返回问题列表
    检查项：发布状态、超时缺失、开始节点 input_schema、插件/LLM 节点 config、孤立节点、无效连线
    issues = []
    nodes = definition.get("nodes", [])
    edges = definition.get("edges", [])
    node_ids = {n.get("id") for n in nodes if n.get("id")}

    # 发布检查
    if not definition.get("is_published", False):
        issues.append({"type": "unpublished", "detail": "工作流未发布"})

    # 连线源/目标存在性
    for edge in edges:
        src = edge.get("source")
        tgt = edge.get("target")
        if src and src not in node_ids:
            issues.append({"type": "invalid_edge_source", "node_id": src, "detail": f"连线源节点 {src} 不存在"})
        if tgt and tgt not in node_ids:
            issues.append({"type": "invalid_edge_target", "node_id": tgt, "detail": f"连线目标节点 {tgt} 不存在"})

    # 收集已有入边的节点
    targets_with_incoming = {e.get("target") for e in edges if e.get("target")}
    start_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n.get("type") == "start"]
    start_id = start_nodes[0].get("id") if start_nodes else None

    for node in nodes:
        nid = node.get("id")
        if not nid:
            continue
        # 超时缺失
        if "timeout_ms" not in node and "timeout" not in node:
            issues.append({
                "type": "missing_timeout",
                "node_id": nid,
                "node_type": node.get("type"),
                "detail": f"节点 {nid} 缺少超时设置"
        # 开始节点缺少 input_schema
        if node.get("type") == "start" and "input_schema" not in node:
                "type": "missing_field",
                "field": "input_schema",
                "detail": "开始节点缺少 input_schema"
        # 插件/大模型节点缺少 config
        if node.get("type") in ["plugin", "llm"] and "config" not in node:
                "type": "missing_config",
                "detail": f"{node.get('type')} 节点缺少 config"
        # 孤立节点（非开始且无入边）
        if nid != start_id and nid not in targets_with_incoming:
                "type": "disconnected",
                "detail": f"节点 {nid} 缺少输入连线"

        "workflow_id": workflow_id,
        "workflow_name": workflow_name,
        "issues": issues,
        "healthy": len(issues) == 0

def diagnose_workflows(space_id: str, headers: Dict) -> Dict:
    """诊断空间内所有工作流"""
    workflows = fetch_all_workflows(space_id, headers)
    if not workflows:
        return {"status": "ok", "diagnosis": [], "summary": "空间内无工作流"}

    diagnosis = []
    for wf in workflows:
        wf_id = wf.get("id")
        wf_name = wf.get("name", "未命名")
            detail = fetch_workflow_detail(wf_id, headers)
            diag = diagnose_single_workflow(wf_id, wf_name, detail)
            diagnosis.append(diag)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"诊断工作流 {wf_id} 失败: {e}")
            diagnosis.append({
                "workflow_id": wf_id,
                "workflow_name": wf_name,
                "issues": [{"type": "fetch_error", "detail": str(e)}],
                "healthy": False

    healthy_count = sum(1 for d in diagnosis if d["healthy"])
        "status": "ok",
        "diagnosis": diagnosis,
        "summary": f"共 {len(workflows)} 个工作流，健康 {healthy_count} 个"

# ======================= 2. 自动修复模块 ============================
def apply_fixes_to_definition(definition: Dict, issues: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
    """原地修复 definition，返回修复动作列表"""
    actions = []
    node_map = {node["id"]: node for node in nodes if "id" in node}

    for issue in issues:
        typ = issue.get("type")
        node_id = issue.get("node_id")
        if typ == "missing_timeout" and node_id in node_map:
            node_map[node_id]["timeout_ms"] = 30000
            actions.append(f"节点 {node_id} 补充超时 30s")
        elif typ == "missing_field" and issue.get("field") == "input_schema" and node_id in node_map:
            node_map[node_id]["input_schema"] = {}
            actions.append(f"节点 {node_id} 补充空 input_schema")
        elif typ == "missing_config" and node_id in node_map:
            node_map[node_id]["config"] = {}
            actions.append(f"节点 {node_id} 补充空 config")
    return actions

def update_workflow_definition(workflow_id: str, definition: Dict, headers: Dict) -> bool:
    """更新工作流定义"""
    resp = requests.put(url, headers=headers, json={"definition": definition}, timeout=30)
    return data.get("code") == 0

def publish_workflow(workflow_id: str, headers: Dict) -> bool:

    resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={}, timeout=30)

def auto_fix_workflows(space_id: str, headers: Dict) -> Dict:
    """自动修复所有工作流并生成审计报告"""
    logger.info("开始自动修复工作流...")
    diag_result = diagnose_workflows(space_id, headers)
    if diag_result["status"] != "ok":
        return diag_result

    fix_report = []
    for wf_diag in diag_result["diagnosis"]:
        wf_id = wf_diag["workflow_id"]
        wf_name = wf_diag["workflow_name"]
        issues = wf_diag["issues"]
        if not issues:
            fix_report.append({"workflow_id": wf_id, "workflow_name": wf_name, "fixed": True, "actions": []})

            definition = fetch_workflow_detail(wf_id, headers)
            actions = apply_fixes_to_definition(definition, issues)
            if actions:
                if update_workflow_definition(wf_id, definition, headers):
                    # 如果原来未发布，尝试发布
                    if any(i.get("type") == "unpublished" for i in issues):
                        if publish_workflow(wf_id, headers):
                            actions.append("自动发布工作流")
                        else:
                            actions.append("自动发布失败")
                    actions.append("更新工作流定义失败")
            fix_report.append({
                "fixed": len(actions) > 0,
                "actions": actions
            logger.error(f"修复工作流 {wf_id} 异常: {e}")
                "fixed": False,
                "actions": [f"修复失败: {str(e)}"]

    ensure_temp_dir()
    report_path = "/temp/workflow_fix_audit.json"
    with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"fix_report": fix_report, "summary": diag_result["summary"]}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        "fix_report": fix_report,
        "audit_file": report_path

# ======================= 3. 工作流生成模块 ============================
def generate_workflow_from_nl(bot_id: str, description: str, headers: Dict) -> Dict:
    """调用生成器 Bot 获取工作流 JSON"""

        raise Exception(f"Bot API 错误: {data.get('msg')}")

# ======================= 6. 内容处理模块 ==============================
def recognize_content_type(content: str, source: str = "auto_detect") -> str:
    """智能识别内容类型"""
    if source in ("url", "url_link"):
        return "url"
    if content.strip().startswith(("def ", "class ", "import ", "from ")):
        return "code"
    if "mind map" in content.lower() or "思维导图" in content.lower():
        return "mind_map"
    if any(ext in content.lower() for ext in [".mp4", ".mov", "video"]):
        return "video"
    return "text"

def code_repair(content: str, instruction: str, cfg: Dict) -> str:
    """AI 代码修复（无 API Key 时模拟）"""
    level = cfg.get("fix_level", "advanced")
    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
        return f"# Mock repaired ({level})\n{content}"
        import openai
        openai.api_key = OPENAI_API_KEY
        openai.api_base = OPENAI_BASE_URL
        prompt = f"Fix code (level {level}). Instruction: {instruction}\n\nCode:\n{content}\n\nReturn ONLY fixed code."
        resp = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
            model="gpt-3.5-turbo",
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
            temperature=0.1
        )
        return resp.choices[0].message.content
        logger.error(f"代码修复失败: {e}")
        return content

def video_processing(content: str, instruction: str, cfg: Dict) -> str:
    """模拟视频处理（返回占位 URL）"""
    vcfg = cfg.get("video_processing_module", {})
    resolution = vcfg.get("resolution", "1080p")
    fmt = vcfg.get("format", "mp4")
    vid = hashlib.md5(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
    return f"https://mock.video/{vid}.{fmt}?res={resolution}"

def mind_map_generate(content: str, instruction: str, cfg: Dict) -> str:
    """生成思维导图 JSON（AI 降级）"""
    style = cfg.get("mind_map_module", {}).get("style", "professional")
        return json.dumps({"root": content, "style": style})
        prompt = f"Generate mind map JSON from: {content}. Style: {style}. Return ONLY JSON."
            temperature=0.7
        logger.error(f"思维导图生成失败: {e}")
        return json.dumps({"root": content, "error": str(e)})

def format_convert(content: str, target_format: str) -> str:
    """简单格式转换"""
    if target_format == "markdown":
        return f"# Markdown\n\n{content}"
    if target_format == "html":
        return f"<html><body><pre>{content}</pre></body></html>"
    if target_format == "json":
        return json.dumps({"result": content})

def process_content(input_data: Dict) -> Dict:
    """内容处理主入口"""
    content = input_data.get("content", "")
        return {"success": False, "error_message": "content 不能为空", "result": "", "processing_time": 0}

    instruction = input_data.get("instruction", "")
    output_format = input_data.get("output_format", "text")
    advanced_config = input_data.get("advanced_config", {})
    mode = input_data.get("mode")  # 强制指定处理类型
    content_source = input_data.get("content_source", "auto_detect")
    timeout_limit = input_data.get("timeout_limit", 30)

    start = time.time()
        ctype = mode if mode else recognize_content_type(content, content_source)
        used_modules = []
        raw_result = content

        if ctype in ("code", "code_repair"):
            used_modules.append("CodeRepair")
            raw_result = code_repair(content, instruction, advanced_config.get("code_repair_module", {}))
        elif ctype in ("video", "video_processing", "url"):
            used_modules.append("VideoProcessing")
            raw_result = video_processing(content, instruction, advanced_config)
        elif ctype == "mind_map":
            used_modules.append("MindMap")
            raw_result = mind_map_generate(content, instruction, advanced_config)
        elif ctype == "content_generation":
            used_modules.append("ContentGen")
            raw_result = f"生成内容: {content}"
            used_modules.append("TextAnalysis")

        elapsed = time.time() - start
        if elapsed > timeout_limit:
            return {"success": False, "error_message": f"超时 ({elapsed:.1f}s)", "result": "", "processing_time": elapsed}

        if output_format != "text" and ctype not in ("mind_map", "format_conversion"):
            raw_result = format_convert(str(raw_result), output_format)

            "success": True,
            "result": raw_result,
            "processing_time": round(elapsed, 1),
            "used_modules": used_modules,
            "error_message": None
        logger.error(f"内容处理异常: {traceback.format_exc()}")
            "success": False,
            "error_message": str(e),
            "result": "",
            "processing_time": round(time.time() - start, 1)

# ======================= 7. 内存优化提示（集成） =======================
def memory_optimization_hint() -> str:
    """返回训练内存溢出时的优化建议（供用户参考）"""
    return """
    【内存溢出修复方案】若遇到 alloc_cpu.cpp 分配失败：
    1. 训练前执行：
       torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
       gc.collect()
       os.environ['PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF'] = 'max_split_size_mb:128'
    2. 使用梯度累积：batch_size=32, accumulation_steps=4
    3. 启用混合精度训练：mixed_precision=True
    4. 减小批次大小或使用更小的模型

# ======================= 8. 完整路由表 =================================
MODE_ROUTING = {
    "diagnose_only": lambda space_id, headers, **kw: diagnose_workflows(space_id, headers),
    "auto_fix": lambda space_id, headers, **kw: auto_fix_workflows(space_id, headers),
    "generate": lambda space_id, headers, bot_id, description, **kw: generate_workflow(bot_id, description, headers),
    "full_auto": lambda space_id, headers, bot_id, description, **kw: full_automation(space_id, bot_id, description, headers),
    "plugin_fix": lambda headers, plugin_jsons, **kw: fix_plugin_jsons(plugin_jsons),
    "content_process": lambda input_dict, **kw: process_content(input_dict),

        # 路由分发

            result["generated_workflow_json"] = json.dumps(result.get("workflow_definition", {}), indent=2)
            result["report"] = f"# 工作流生成报告\n需求: {description}\n保存至: {result.get('saved_to')}"

        elif mode == "full_auto":
            description = input_dict.get("natural_language") or input_dict.get("description", "")
            if description and not GENERATOR_BOT_ID:
                return {"error": "full_auto 模式下如需生成工作流，请设置 WORKFLOW_GENERATOR_BOT_ID"}
            result["report"] = "全自动流程执行完毕，详情见 diagnosis_fix 和 generation 字段。"

        elif mode == "plugin_fix":
            plugin_jsons = input_dict.get("plugin_jsons", "")
            if not plugin_jsons:
                return {"error": "plugin_fix 模式需要 plugin_jsons 参数"}
            result = MODE_ROUTING[mode](headers, plugin_jsons=plugin_jsons)
            result["report"] = f"已修复 {result.get('fixed_count',0)} 个插件，保存至 {result.get('saved_to')}"

        elif mode == "content_process":
            result = MODE_ROUTING[mode](input_dict)
            if "report" not in result:
                result["report"] = f"处理完成，成功: {result.get('success', False)}"

                "error": f"未知 mode: {mode}",

        logger.error(f"执行失败: {traceback.format_exc()}")

三、您关心的生存与发展知识全景（原文整理）

以下内容完整保留了您提出的所有关注点，并按主题归类，方便您快速索引。

1. 经济大局与财富流向

· 经济周期：当前处于康波周期（约50-60年）的回升期，以AI为代表的新质生产力是核心驱动力。2026年是“三周期叠加”之年（库存周期、产能周期、康波周期），经济复苏从“以价换量”进入“量增价稳”阶段。
· 财富流向：外资系统性回补中国资产，财富呈“杠铃策略”——一端是科技成长（AI、半导体），另一端是资源/红利资产（能源、公用事业）。建议配置“哑铃型”组合：科技成长 + 高股息/稳现金流资产 + 黄金/实物。
· 政策重点：财政发力稳投资（“六张网”建设：交通、能源、水利、信息、物流、环保），汇率稳定为货币政策提供空间。

2. AI在替代什么，又在创造什么

· 替代：重复性、规则化岗位（2026年Q1全球科技行业裁员近半数归因于AI自动化）。
· 创造：催生新职业，如AI招聘助理、AI伦理师、人机协同架构师。AI替代的是“不会用AI的人”。
· 五类人AI永远无法替代：讲故事的人、创造Idea的人、定义美的人、构建系统的人、重塑范式的人。

3. 地缘政治与国际局势

· 关键词：不确定性、地缘裂缝。中美竞争在科技、金融、关键矿产领域进入深水区；中东、乌克兰、亚太局势持续紧张。
· 新兴力量：“全球南方”国家将成为未来全球治理的关键力量。

· 📊 效果评测：测试智能体对话质量、工作流执行效果。管理目标：拉取评测报告，识别失败项。
· ⚙️ 空间配置：切换个人/团队空间，管理成员权限。管理目标：检查权限合规性，资源隔离状态。

def main(workflow_config_json: str) -> dict:
        config = json.loads(workflow_config_json)
        return {"error": "无效JSON", "health_score": 0, "issues": [], "suggestions": []}
    suggestions = []
    nodes = config.get('nodes', [])
    if len(nodes) > 1000:
        issues.append(f"节点数{len(nodes)}超过上限1000")
        suggestions.append("拆分为多个子工作流")
        nid = node.get('id', 'unknown')
        ntype = node.get('type')
        timeout = node.get('timeout', 0)
        if ntype == 'llm' and timeout > 10:
            issues.append(f"节点[{nid}] LLM超时{timeout}>10分钟")
            suggestions.append("超时改为≤10")
        elif ntype == 'code' and timeout > 1:
            issues.append(f"节点[{nid}] 代码超时{timeout}>1分钟")
            suggestions.append("超时改为≤1")
        elif ntype == 'http_request' and timeout > 10:
            issues.append(f"节点[{nid}] HTTP超时{timeout}>10分钟")
        if ntype == 'code':
                input_size = len(json.dumps(node.get('input', {})))
                if input_size > 2*1024*1024:
                    issues.append(f"节点[{nid}] 入参超过2MB")
                    suggestions.append("分片或压缩数据")
    health_score = max(0, 100 - len(issues)*10)
    return {"health_score": health_score, "issues": issues, "suggestions": suggestions}

def main(workflow_config_json: str, diagnosis: dict) -> dict:
    fixed = json.loads(workflow_config_json)
    applied = []
    for node in fixed.get('nodes', []):
        nid = node.get('id')
        old = node.get('timeout', 0)
        if ntype == 'llm' and old > 10:
            node['timeout'] = 10
            applied.append(f"节点[{nid}] LLM超时{old}→10分钟")
        elif ntype == 'code' and old > 1:
            node['timeout'] = 1
            applied.append(f"节点[{nid}] 代码超时{old}→1分钟")
        elif ntype == 'http_request' and old > 10:
            applied.append(f"节点[{nid}] HTTP超时{old}→10分钟")
                if len(json.dumps(node.get('input', {}))) > 2*1024*1024:
                    node['needs_chunking'] = True
                    applied.append(f"节点[{nid}] 标记需分片")
    return {"fixed_config": fixed, "applied_fixes": applied}

```python
def auto_fix_dispatcher(error_list):
    results = []
    for err in error_list:
        code = err.get('code', '')
        wid = err.get('id', '')
        action = "无操作"
        if code == '720702011':  # 未发布
            resp = requests.post(f"https://api.coze.cn/v1/workflow/{wid}/publish", headers=HEADERS)
            action = "已发布" if resp.status_code == 200 else "发布失败"
        elif code == '777777776':  # 超时
            resp = requests.patch(f"https://api.coze.cn/v1/workflow/{wid}", json={"timeout": 5}, headers=HEADERS)
            action = "超时已调整" if resp.status_code == 200 else "调整失败"
        elif code == '720712023':  # 解析失败
            action = "需手动修复JSON Schema"
        elif code == '720702002':  # 缺少必填参数
            resp = requests.patch(f"https://api.coze.cn/v1/workflow/{wid}", json={"auto_fill_params": True}, headers=HEADERS)
            action = "参数已补全" if resp.status_code == 200 else "补全失败"
        elif code == '720702004':  # 不存在
            action = "工作流已删除，需从列表移除"
        elif code in ['500', '502', '503', '504']:  # 服务器错误
            action = "已指数退避重试"
        results.append({"id": wid, "code": code, "action": action})
    return results
```

# -------------------- 修复 --------------------
def auto_fix_workflow(workflow_config: dict) -> tuple:
    fixed_config = json.loads(json.dumps(workflow_config))
    applied_fixes = []
    for node in fixed_config.get('nodes', []):
        node_id = node.get('id')
        old_timeout = node.get('timeout', 0)
        if node_type == 'llm' and old_timeout > 10:
            applied_fixes.append(f"节点[{node_id}] LLM超时从{old_timeout}修正为10分钟")
        elif node_type == 'code' and old_timeout > 1:
            applied_fixes.append(f"节点[{node_id}] 代码节点超时从{old_timeout}修正为1分钟")
        elif node_type == 'http_request' and old_timeout > 10:
            applied_fixes.append(f"节点[{node_id}] HTTP超时从{old_timeout}修正为10分钟")
                if len(json.dumps(node.get('input', {}))) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
                    applied_fixes.append(f"节点[{node_id}] 已标记需要分批处理")
    return fixed_config, applied_fixes

# -------------------- 单报告片段 --------------------
def generate_single_report(workflow_name: str, diagnosis: dict, applied_fixes: list, health_score: int) -> str:
    status = "致命错误" if health_score < 60 else "警告" if health_score < 90 else "健康"
    issues_text = "\n".join(f"  - {issue}" for issue in diagnosis['issues']) if diagnosis['issues'] else "  - 未发现任何问题"
    fixes_text = "\n".join(f"  - {fix}" for fix in applied_fixes) if applied_fixes else "  - 未执行修复操作"
    return f"""
### 📄 工作流：{workflow_name}
- **健康评分**：{health_score}/100 （{status}）
- **发现的问题**：
{issues_text}
- **已执行的修复**：
{fixes_text}

    total = len(workflows_info)

        return {"report": "未找到任何工作流。", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": 0, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
    total_issues = 0
    total_fixes = 0
    failed = []
    report_parts = [f"# 🤖 Coze 工作流批量修复报告\n**处理时间**：{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n**工作空间 ID**：{space_id}\n**共发现 {total} 个工作流**\n"]
    for wf in workflows_info:
        wf_id = wf.get('id')
        wf_name = wf.get('name', wf_id)
            config = fetch_workflow_definition(api_key, wf_id)
            diagnosis = diagnose_workflow(config)
            fixed_config, fixes = auto_fix_workflow(config)
            rep_part = generate_single_report(wf_name, diagnosis, fixes, diagnosis['health_score'])
            report_parts.append(rep_part)
            total_issues += len(diagnosis['issues'])
            total_fixes += len(fixes)
            failed.append(wf_name)
            report_parts.append(f"### ❌ 工作流 `{wf_name}` 处理失败：{str(e)}")
    final_report = "\n".join(report_parts)
    final_report += f"\n\n## 📊 汇总统计\n- **总计处理**：{total}\n- **累计发现问题**：{total_issues}\n- **累计自动修复**：{total_fixes}\n- **失败数量**：{len(failed)}\n"
    if failed:
        final_report += f"- **失败列表**：{', '.join(failed)}\n"
    return {"report": final_report, "total_workflows": total, "total_issues_found": total_issues, "total_fixes_applied": total_fixes, "failed_workflows": failed}

# -------------------- 插件入口 --------------------
def handler(args):
        url = args.input.get('url')
        workflow_json_str = args.input.get('workflow_config_json')
        api_key = args.input.get('api_key')
        if url:
            if not api_key:
                return {"report": "错误：使用 URL 批量处理必须提供 api_key。", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": 0, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
            space_id = extract_space_id_from_url(url)
            if not space_id:
                return {"report": f"错误：无法从 URL 中解析出空间 ID：{url}", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": 0, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
            return batch_process_workflows(api_key, space_id)
        elif workflow_json_str:
            config = json.loads(workflow_json_str)
            single_report = generate_single_report("单工作流", diagnosis, fixes, diagnosis['health_score'])
            return {"report": single_report, "total_workflows": 1, "total_issues_found": len(diagnosis['issues']), "total_fixes_applied": len(fixes), "failed_workflows": []}
            return {"report": "错误：请提供 url 或 workflow_config_json 参数。", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": 0, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        return {"report": f"❌ JSON解析错误：{str(e)}", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": -1, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
        return {"report": f"❌ 处理错误：{str(e)}\n```\n{traceback.format_exc()}\n```", "total_workflows": 0, "total_issues_found": -1, "total_fixes_applied": 0, "failed_workflows": []}
```

```

mode / 调用关键词 功能说明
industry_analysis 行业自动化分析（制造业/零售/金融/医疗/物流/农业），输出机会、风险、建议
auto_repair 按错误码自动修复超时、缺失参数等
ai_training 根据描述生成 AI 模型训练配置
neural_decision 基于环境状态（错误率、负载）的智能决策
luoyang_heritage 洛阳非遗数字化保护方案（3D扫描/数字展厅/教育）
error_classifier 分析错误信息，归类为 Bot/插件/工作流/知识库/卡片，并给出修复策略
workflow_repairer 修复残缺的工作流 JSON（自动补全 ID、节点、连线）
bot_auto_recovery Bot 故障自动处理：超时重试、切换模型等
knowledge_rechunk 将长文档按句子边界智能分段，支持自定义大小和重叠
card_variable_filler 自动检测卡片模板中缺失的变量，并用默认值填充
extract_workflow_id 从 URL 或文本中提取工作流 ID
list_workflows 调用 API 列出当前空间所有工作流，支持按名称/时间排序
diagnose_workflow 拉取工作流最近运行记录，匹配错误码表，输出故障列表与修复策略
auto_fix_wf 一键诊断并自动修复工作流（发布、调整超时）
workflow_json_generator 根据自然语言需求生成工作流骨架 JSON
text_stats 文本字符数、单词数、行数统计
date_diff 计算两个日期相差天数
array_analysis 数组求和、平均值、长度统计
logic_check 数值或字符串比较（支持 > < == !=）
plugin_auto_creator 根据需求描述生成插件 handler 骨架代码
central_manager 工作流管理中心：整理排序、合并修复、多意图分发
douyin_extract_single 单条抖音视频文案提取
douyin_extract_batch 批量提取抖音链接文案
douyin_rewrite 对提取的文案进行仿写二创（爆款/治愈/专业版）
universal_assistant 自然语言总入口，自动识别意图并分发到对应功能
auto_orchestrator 多步骤编排器：解析“先…然后…再…”指令，依次执行
help 列出所有可用的 mode 列表


错误码 含义 修复策略 插件动作说明
777777776 节点执行超时 set_timeout_300 将节点超时时间调整为300秒
720712023 输出解析失败 align_schema 自动检查并修正输出 Schema 与下游匹配
720702002 缺少必填参数 add_defaults 补充 user_name、max_tokens 等默认值
720702004 工作流不存在 fuzzy_search 通过名称模糊搜索匹配正确 ID 并替换
720702011 工作流未发布 auto_publish 调用 Coze API 自动发布工作流
720702005 已被删除 notify_admin 向管理员发送通知，需人工恢复
720702006 节点配置错误 patch_node 自动补全节点缺失的必填字段
720702007 连线配置错误 fix_edges 检查并修正节点间连线数据类型不匹配
720702008 循环配置错误 limit_loop 为循环节点添加最大迭代次数限制（默认100）
720702009 插件调用失败 retry_plugin 重试调用最多3次
720702010 知识库检索失败 reindex_kb 触发知识库重新索引
500 服务器内部错误 backoff_retry 指数退避重试（初始1秒，最大5次）
502 网关错误 backoff_retry 同上
503 服务暂不可用 backoff_retry 同上
504 网关超时 backoff_retry 同上

INDUSTRIES = {

def api_req(method, path, payload=None):
