🎯 Trae-CN 软件问题分析与完整解决方案
从你的描述来看，使用 Trae-CN 软件生成的操作出现了多个问题。让我帮你分析并提供完整的修复方案：

🔍 问题根本原因分析
Trae-CN 软件常见问题：
配置不完整 - 生成的操作缺少关键配置

端口冲突 - 默认配置与其他服务冲突

网络配置错误 - 容器网络设置不正确

依赖服务缺失 - 没有正确配置数据库、缓存等服务

模型配置错误 - API 密钥或模型端点配置不正确

🛠 完整修复方案
第一步：清理 Trae-CN 生成的问题环境
# 1. 停止所有相关容器
docker stop $(docker ps -a -q --filter "name=coze")
docker stop $(docker ps -a -q --filter "name=trae")

# 2. 删除所有相关容器
docker rm $(docker ps -a -q --filter "name=coze")
docker rm $(docker ps -a -q --filter "name=trae")

# 3. 清理 Docker 网络和卷
docker network prune -f
docker volume prune -f

# 4. 检查残留文件（Windows）
# 在以下位置查找残留配置文件：
# C:\ProgramData\Docker\config
# C:\Users\你的用户名\.docker
# C:\trae-cn 或 C:\coze
第二步：手动创建正确的 Docker 配置
创建以下配置文件，避免使用 Trae-CN 生成的错误配置：

1. 创建项目目录结构
coze-complete/
├── docker-compose.yml
├── .env
├── config/
│   └── model_config.yaml
├── scripts/
│   ├── start-all.bat
│   └── health-check.py
└── data/
    ├── postgres/
    └── redis/
2. 创建正确的 docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  # PostgreSQL 数据库
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: coze-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME:-coze_db}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER:-admin}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-secure_password123}
    volumes:
      - ./data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./config/postgres-init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U admin"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - coze-network

  # Redis 缓存
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: coze-redis
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
      - ./data/redis:/data
      - "6379:6379"
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]

  # Coze Loop 核心服务（开源版本）
  coze-loop-server:
    image: cozeai/coze-loop:latest
    container_name: coze-loop-server
    depends_on:
        condition: service_healthy
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://admin:secure_password123@postgres:5432/coze_db
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - MODEL_CONFIG_PATH=/app/config/model_config.yaml
      - API_KEY=${COZE_API_KEY}
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - ./config/model_config.yaml:/app/config/model_config.yaml
      - ./data/coze:/app/data
      - "3000:3000"
    restart: unless-stopped
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

  # Coze Studio 前端界面
  coze-studio:
    image: cozeai/studio:latest
    container_name: coze-studio
      - REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
      - REACT_APP_WS_URL=ws://localhost:3000
      - PORT=8888
      - "8888:8888"

  # n8n 工作流引擎（可选）
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: coze-n8n
      - N8N_PROTOCOL=http
      - N8N_HOST=localhost
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=http://localhost:5678
      - WEBHOOK_URL=http://localhost:5678
      - N8N_METRICS=true
      - ./data/n8n:/home/node/.n8n
      - "5678:5678"

  # 模型服务（可选，使用 Ollama 作为本地模型）
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: coze-ollama
      - ./data/ollama:/root/.ollama
      - "11434:11434"

  coze-network:
    driver: bridge
    name: coze-network
3. 创建 .env 配置文件
env
# 数据库配置
DB_NAME=coze_db
DB_USER=admin
DB_PASSWORD=secure_password123

# Coze API 配置
COZE_API_KEY=your_coze_api_key_here

# 服务端口配置
COZE_STUDIO_PORT=8888
COZE_LOOP_PORT=3000
N8N_PORT=5678
OLLAMA_PORT=11434

# 模型配置（火山方舟示例）
VOLCENGINE_API_KEY=your_volcengine_api_key_here
VOLCENGINE_MODEL_ENDPOINT=ep-20241210141520-aaaaa

# 可选：OpenAI 兼容接口
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-your-openai-key
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
4. 创建正确的 model_config.yaml
# model_config.yaml
models:
  # 火山方舟模型（国内推荐）
  volcengine-ark:
    name: "VolcEngine Ark"
    type: "openai"
    base_url: "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3"
    api_key: "${VOLCENGINE_API_KEY}"
    model: "${VOLCENGINE_MODEL_ENDPOINT}"
    max_tokens: 4096
    timeout: 60

  # 本地 Ollama 模型（备用）
  ollama-local:
    name: "Local Ollama"
    base_url: "http://ollama:11434/v1"
    api_key: "ollama"  # Ollama 不需要真实 API 密钥
    model: "llama3"
    max_tokens: 2048
    timeout: 120

  # OpenAI 兼容接口
  openai-compatible:
    name: "OpenAI Compatible"
    base_url: "${OPENAI_BASE_URL}"
    api_key: "${OPENAI_API_KEY}"
    model: "gpt-3.5-turbo"
    timeout: 30

# 默认模型配置
default_model: "volcengine-ark"
5. 创建数据库初始化脚本
创建 config/postgres-init.sql：

sql
-- 初始化 Coze 数据库
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS coze_db;

-- 创建扩展（如果需要）
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 创建用户表（示例）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    username VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 创建索引
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_username ON users(username);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email ON users(email);
第三步：创建智能启动脚本
Windows 版本：start-all.bat
title Coze 完整环境启动器
color 0A
echo =============================================
echo        Coze 完整环境一键启动脚本
echo        （绕过 Trae-CN 问题）
echo.

REM 检查 Docker 是否运行
echo [1/6] 检查 Docker 服务状态...
docker --version >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo ❌ Docker 未安装或未启动
    echo 请先启动 Docker Desktop
    exit /b 1
echo ✅ Docker 已安装

REM 清理旧环境
echo [2/6] 清理旧容器和网络...
docker-compose down >nul 2>&1
timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul

REM 创建必要目录
echo [3/6] 创建数据目录...
if not exist "data\postgres" mkdir data\postgres
if not exist "data\redis" mkdir data\redis
if not exist "data\coze" mkdir data\coze
if not exist "data\n8n" mkdir data\n8n
if not exist "data\ollama" mkdir data\ollama

REM 检查配置文件
echo [4/6] 检查配置文件...
if not exist ".env" (
    echo ⚠️  .env 文件不存在，创建示例配置...
    copy /Y ".env.example" ".env"
    echo 请编辑 .env 文件配置 API 密钥

if not exist "config\model_config.yaml" (
    echo ⚠️  model_config.yaml 不存在，创建示例...
    if not exist "config" mkdir config
    copy /Y "config\model_config.yaml.example" "config\model_config.yaml"

REM 启动服务
echo [5/6] 启动所有服务...
echo 这可能需要几分钟，请耐心等待...
docker-compose up -d

REM 等待服务启动
echo [6/6] 等待服务初始化...
timeout /t 30 /nobreak >nul

REM 显示状态
echo          服务启动状态
docker-compose ps

echo          访问地址
echo 1. Coze Studio:    http://localhost:8888
echo 2. Coze Loop API:  http://localhost:3000
echo 3. n8n 工作流:     http://localhost:5678
echo 4. Ollama 模型:    http://localhost:11434

REM 检查服务健康
echo 正在检查服务健康状态...
call :check_health "Coze Studio" "http://localhost:8888"
call :check_health "Coze Loop API" "http://localhost:3000/health"
call :check_health "n8n" "http://localhost:5678/healthz"

echo ✅ 所有服务已启动完成！
echo 重要提示：
echo 1. 首次访问可能需要配置账号
echo 2. 确保 .env 文件中的 API 密钥已正确配置
echo 3. 查看日志：docker-compose logs -f
exit /b 0

:check_health
echo 检查 %1...
powershell -Command "try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '%2' -TimeoutSec 5; if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { Write-Host '✅ %1: 正常' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️  %1: 状态码 $response.StatusCode' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } catch { Write-Host '❌ %1: 连接失败' -ForegroundColor Red }"
Linux/Mac 版本：start-all.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "============================================="
echo "      Coze 完整环境一键启动脚本"
echo "      （绕过 Trae-CN 问题）"
echo

# 检查 Docker
echo "[1/6] 检查 Docker 服务状态..."
if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ Docker 未安装"

if ! docker info &> /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ Docker 未运行"
echo "✅ Docker 已安装并运行"

# 清理旧环境
echo "[2/6] 清理旧容器和网络..."
docker-compose down 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2

# 创建目录
echo "[3/6] 创建数据目录..."
mkdir -p data/postgres data/redis data/coze data/n8n data/ollama
mkdir -p config

# 检查配置文件
echo "[4/6] 检查配置文件..."
if [ ! -f ".env" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  .env 文件不存在，创建示例配置..."
    if [ -f ".env.example" ]; then
        echo "请创建 .env 文件并配置 API 密钥"

if [ ! -f "config/model_config.yaml" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  model_config.yaml 不存在，创建示例..."
    if [ -f "config/model_config.yaml.example" ]; then
        cp config/model_config.yaml.example config/model_config.yaml
        echo "请创建 config/model_config.yaml"

# 启动服务
echo "[5/6] 启动所有服务..."
echo "这可能需要几分钟，请耐心等待..."

# 等待服务启动
echo "[6/6] 等待服务初始化..."
sleep 30

# 显示状态
echo "          服务启动状态"

echo "          访问地址"
echo "1. Coze Studio:    http://localhost:8888"
echo "2. Coze Loop API:  http://localhost:3000"
echo "3. n8n 工作流:     http://localhost:5678"
echo "4. Ollama 模型:    http://localhost:11434"

# 健康检查
check_health() {
    local name=$1
    local url=$2
    
    echo -n "检查 $name..."
    if curl -f -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 "$url"; then
        echo " ✅ 正常"
        echo " ❌ 连接失败"

echo "正在检查服务健康状态..."
check_health "Coze Studio" "http://localhost:8888"
check_health "Coze Loop API" "http://localhost:3000/health"
check_health "n8n" "http://localhost:5678/healthz"

echo "✅ 所有服务已启动完成！"
echo "重要提示："
echo "1. 首次访问可能需要配置账号"
echo "2. 确保 .env 文件中的 API 密钥已正确配置"
echo "3. 查看日志：docker-compose logs -f"
第四步：故障排除和监控
创建监控脚本：monitor-services.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import time
import sys
from datetime import datetime

SERVICES = [
    {"name": "Coze Studio", "url": "http://localhost:8888", "port": 8888},
    {"name": "Coze Loop API", "url": "http://localhost:3000/health", "port": 3000},
    {"name": "n8n Workflow", "url": "http://localhost:5678/healthz", "port": 5678},
    {"name": "PostgreSQL", "url": None, "port": 5432},
    {"name": "Redis", "url": None, "port": 6379},

def check_port(host, port):
    """检查端口是否开放"""
    import socket
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.settimeout(2)
        result = sock.connect_ex((host, port))
        sock.close()
        return result == 0
    except Exception:
        return False

def check_http_service(name, url):
    """检查HTTP服务"""
        start_time = time.time()
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
        response_time = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
        
        if 200 <= response.status_code < 300:
            return True, f"✅ {name}: 正常 (响应时间: {response_time:.0f}ms)"
            return False, f"⚠️  {name}: 异常 (状态码: {response.status_code})"
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        return False, f"❌ {name}: 连接失败 - {str(e)[:50]}"

def main():
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Coze 服务监控 - {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print(f"{'='*60}\n")
    
    all_ok = True
    
    for service in SERVICES:
        if service["url"]:
            ok, message = check_http_service(service["name"], service["url"])
            ok = check_port("localhost", service["port"])
            message = f"✅ {service['name']}: 端口 {service['port']} 正常" if ok else f"❌ {service['name']}: 端口 {service['port']} 未开放"
        
        print(message)
        if not ok:
            all_ok = False
    
    if all_ok:
        print("✅ 所有服务运行正常")
        print("⚠️  部分服务异常，请检查")
        print("\n建议操作：")
        print("1. 查看日志: docker-compose logs -f")
        print("2. 重启服务: docker-compose restart")
        print("3. 重新创建: docker-compose down && docker-compose up -d")
    
    print(f"{'='*60}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ==================== 初始化NLTK和spaCy ====================
class ResourceManager:
    """资源管理器 - 处理NLTK和spaCy资源下载"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def setup_nltk():
        """设置NLTK数据路径"""
        try:
            nltk_data_path = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'nltk_data')
            if not os.path.exists(nltk_data_path):
                os.makedirs(nltk_data_path)
            nltk.data.path.append(nltk_data_path)
            
            # 尝试下载必要的NLTK数据
            resources = ['punkt', 'stopwords', 'wordnet']
            for resource in resources:
                    nltk.data.find(f'tokenizers/{resource}' if resource == 'punkt' else f'corpora/{resource}')
                except LookupError:
                    print(f"下载NLTK资源: {resource}")
                    nltk.download(resource, quiet=True)
                    
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"NLTK设置警告: {e}")

    def setup_spacy():
        """设置spaCy模型"""
            return spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
        except OSError:
            print("spaCy模型未找到，使用简化处理模式")
            return None

# 初始化资源
ResourceManager.setup_nltk()
nlp = ResourceManager.setup_spacy()

# ==================== 核心配置系统 ====================
@dataclass
class SystemConfig:
    """系统配置"""
    data_dirs: List[str] = None
    model_name: str = "microsoft/DialoGPT-medium"
    output_dir: str = "trained_models"
    device_map: str = "auto"
    max_seq_length: int = 2048
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.data_dirs is None:
            self.data_dirs = [
                "documents", "knowledge_base", "conversations", 
                "data/sensor", "data/execution", "data/images"
            ]

# ==================== 多模态数据处理系统 ====================
class MultiModalDataProcessor:
    """多模态数据处理器"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: SystemConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.setup_logging()
        
    def setup_logging(self):
        """设置日志系统"""
        logging.basicConfig(
            level=logging.INFO,
            format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
            handlers=[
                logging.FileHandler('logs/system.log'),
                logging.StreamHandler()
        )
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    def devour_data(self) -> Dict[str, List]:
        """🚀 吞噬数据 - 多模态数据自动采集"""
        self.logger.info("开始吞噬多模态数据...")
        
        data_pool = {
            'text': [],
            'image': [],
            'sensor': [],
            'knowledge': []
        }
        
        for data_dir in self.config.data_dirs:
            if not Path(data_dir).exists():
                self.logger.warning(f"目录不存在: {data_dir}")
                continue
                
            for file_path in Path(data_dir).rglob('*'):
                    if file_path.suffix.lower() in ['.txt', '.md']:
                        data_pool['text'].extend(self._process_text(file_path))
                    elif file_path.suffix.lower() in ['.jpg', '.png', '.jpeg']:
                        data_pool['image'].append(self._process_image(file_path))
                    elif file_path.suffix.lower() in ['.json']:
                        data_pool['knowledge'].extend(self._process_json(file_path))
                    elif file_path.suffix.lower() in ['.csv']:
                        data_pool['sensor'].extend(self._process_csv(file_path))
                    self.logger.error(f"处理文件 {file_path} 时出错: {e}")
        
        self.logger.info(f"数据吞噬完成! 文本: {len(data_pool['text'])} | 图像: {len(data_pool['image'])} | 传感器: {len(data_pool['sensor'])}")
        return data_pool

    def _process_text(self, file_path: Path) -> List[str]:
        """处理文本文件"""
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]

    def _process_image(self, file_path: Path) -> np.ndarray:
        """处理图像文件"""
        img = cv2.imread(str(file_path))
        return cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB) if img is not None else None

    def _process_json(self, file_path: Path) -> List[Dict]:
        """处理JSON文件"""
            data = json.load(f)
            return data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]

    def _process_csv(self, file_path: Path) -> List[Dict]:
        """处理CSV文件"""
        import pandas as pd
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        return df.to_dict('records')

# ==================== 自然语言理解系统 ====================
class NaturalLanguageUnderstanding:
    """自然语言理解引擎"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.stop_words = set(nltk.corpus.stopwords.words('english'))
        self.lemmatizer = nltk.stem.WordNetLemmatizer()
        
    def analyze_text(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """分析文本输入"""
        if nlp is None:
            return self._simple_analysis(text)
        
        # 使用spaCy进行深度分析
        doc = nlp(text)
        
        return {
            'tokens': [token.lemma_ for token in doc],
            'entities': [(ent.text, ent.label_) for ent in doc.ents],
            'syntax': [(token.text, token.dep_) for token in doc],
            'intent': self._classify_intent(text),
            'action_type': self._detect_action_type(text)

    def _simple_analysis(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """简化分析（当spaCy不可用时）"""
        tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(text.lower())
        tokens = [self.lemmatizer.lemmatize(t) for t in tokens if t not in self.stop_words]
        
            'tokens': tokens,
            'entities': [],
            'syntax': [],

    def _classify_intent(self, text: str) -> str:
        """分类意图"""
        intents = {
            'object_manipulation': ['pick', 'place', 'grasp', 'move', 'take', 'put'],
            'navigation': ['go', 'navigate', 'move to', 'find', 'locate'],
            'human_interaction': ['bring', 'follow', 'deliver', 'give', 'show'],
            'maintenance': ['charge', 'check', 'diagnose', 'repair', 'clean']
        
        text_lower = text.lower()
        for intent, keywords in intents.items():
            if any(keyword in text_lower for keyword in keywords):
                return intent
        return 'general'

    def _detect_action_type(self, text: str) -> str:
        """检测动作类型"""
        action_keywords = {
            'manipulation': ['pick', 'place', 'grasp', 'hold', 'release'],
            'movement': ['move', 'go', 'walk', 'navigate', 'turn'],
            'communication': ['say', 'tell', 'ask', 'respond', 'answer'],
            'perception': ['look', 'see', 'detect', 'find', 'identify']
        
        for action_type, keywords in action_keywords.items():
                return action_type
        return 'unknown'

# ==================== 代码生成系统 ====================
class CodeGenerator:
    """智能代码生成引擎"""
    
        self.templates = self._load_templates()
        
    def _load_templates(self) -> Dict[str, List[str]]:
        """加载代码模板"""
        templates = {
            "object_manipulation": [
                "# 物体操控代码",
                "def manipulate_object(target_object, destination):",
                "    # 视觉感知目标物体",
                "    object_position = vision_system.locate_object(target_object)",
                "    # 规划抓取路径", 
                "    grasp_plan = planner.generate_grasp_plan(object_position)",
                "    # 执行抓取动作",
                "    robot_arm.execute_trajectory(grasp_plan)",
                "    # 移动到目标位置",
                "    move_plan = planner.generate_move_plan(destination)",
                "    robot_arm.execute_trajectory(move_plan)",
                "    # 释放物体",
                "    gripper.release()"
            ],
            "navigation": [
                "# 自主导航代码", 
                "def navigate_to(destination):",
                "    # 构建环境地图",
                "    current_map = slam_system.get_current_map()",
                "    # 规划导航路径",
                "    path = path_planner.plan_path(current_map, destination)",
                "    # 执行导航",
                "    for waypoint in path:",
                "        robot_base.move_to(waypoint)",
                "        # 避障检测",
                "        if obstacle_detector.check_collision():",
                "            path_planner.replan_path()",
                "    print('到达目标位置')"
            "human_interaction": [
                "# 人机交互代码",
                "def human_interaction(action, target):",
                "    # 语音识别",
                "    speech_input = speech_recognizer.listen()",
                "    # 意图理解", 
                "    intent = nlp_engine.understand_intent(speech_input)",
                "    # 执行相应动作",
                "    if intent == 'handover':",
                "        perform_handover(target)",
                "    elif intent == 'follow':",
                "        perform_follow_behavior()",
                "    # 语音反馈",
                "    tts_engine.speak('任务完成')"
        return templates

    def generate_code(self, intent: str, entities: List, context: Dict = None) -> str:
        """生成可执行代码"""
        template = self.templates.get(intent, ["# 通用任务代码", "def perform_task():", "    print('执行任务')"])
        
        # 根据实体信息定制代码
        customized_code = []
        for line in template:
            if 'target_object' in line and entities:
                # 替换具体物体名称
                obj_names = [ent[0] for ent in entities if ent[1] in ['OBJECT', 'PRODUCT']]
                if obj_names:
                    line = line.replace('target_object', f"'{obj_names[0]}'")
            customized_code.append(line)
        
        return '\n'.join(customized_code)

        self.cognitive_modules = {

            'navigation': NavigationSystem(),
            'planning': TaskPlanner()

    def execute_code(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """执行生成的代码"""
            # 创建安全执行环境
            safe_globals = {
                'robot_arm': self.actuators['arm'],
                'robot_base': self.actuators['base'], 
                'vision_system': self.cognitive_modules['vision'],
                'planner': self.cognitive_modules['planning'],
                'print': print
            
            # 执行代码
            exec(code, safe_globals)
            return {"status": "success", "message": "代码执行完成"}
            
            return {"status": "error", "message": f"执行错误: {str(e)}"}

        # 缓存结果

        self.logger.info(f"✅ 数据吞噬完成! 总计: {sum(len(v) for v in data_pool.values())} 条数据")
        return dict(data_pool)
    
    async def process_directory(self, directory: str, data_pool: Dict[str, List]):
        """处理单个目录"""
            for file_path in Path(directory).rglob('*'):
                if file_path.is_file():
                    await self.process_file(file_path, data_pool)
            self.logger.error(f"处理目录 {directory} 时出错: {e}")
    
    async def process_file(self, file_path: Path, data_pool: Dict[str, List]):
        """处理单个文件"""
            suffix = file_path.suffix.lower()
            
            if suffix in ['.txt', '.md', '.json']:
                data = await self.process_text_file(file_path)
                data_pool['text'].extend(data)
                
            elif suffix in ['.jpg', '.png', '.jpeg', '.bmp']:
                data = await self.process_image_file(file_path)
                data_pool['images'].append(data)
                
            elif suffix in ['.csv', '.tsv']:
                data = await self.process_csv_file(file_path)
                data_pool['tabular'].extend(data)
                
            elif suffix in ['.yaml', '.yml']:
                data = await self.process_yaml_file(file_path)
                data_pool['config'].append(data)

class TraeNLUEngine:
    """Trae自然语言理解引擎"""
    
    class IntentType(Enum):
        """意图类型枚举"""
        OBJECT_MANIPULATION = auto()
        NAVIGATION = auto()
        HUMAN_INTERACTION = auto()
        MAINTENANCE = auto()
        INFORMATION_QUERY = auto()
        SYSTEM_CONTROL = auto()
    
        self.nlp_model = TraeResourceManager.setup_spacy()
        self.intent_classifier = self.initialize_intent_classifier()
        self.entity_extractor = self.initialize_entity_extractor()
        
    def initialize_intent_classifier(self):
        """初始化意图分类器"""
        # 意图关键词映射
        intent_keywords = {
            self.IntentType.OBJECT_MANIPULATION: [
                "pick", "place", "grasp", "move", "take", "put",
                "抓取", "放置", "移动", "拿起", "放下"
            self.IntentType.NAVIGATION: [
                "go", "navigate", "move to", "find", "locate", "travel",
                "去", "导航", "前往", "找到", "定位"
            self.IntentType.HUMAN_INTERACTION: [
                "bring", "follow", "deliver", "give", "show", "tell",
                "带来", "跟随", "交付", "给予", "展示"
            self.IntentType.MAINTENANCE: [
                "charge", "check", "diagnose", "repair", "clean", "maintain",
                "充电", "检查", "诊断", "修理", "清洁", "维护"
        return intent_keywords
    
    def initialize_entity_extractor(self):
        """初始化实体提取器"""
        # 实体类型定义
        entity_types = {
            "OBJECT": ["杯子", "盒子", "书", "手机", "工具", "瓶子"],
            "LOCATION": ["厨房", "客厅", "卧室", "办公室", "仓库"],
            "PERSON": ["我", "你", "他", "她", "主人", "用户"],
            "ACTION": ["拿", "放", "去", "找", "检查", "修理"],
            "TIME": ["现在", "稍后", "今天", "明天", "马上"]
        return entity_types
    
    def analyze(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            # 基础文本处理
            tokens = self.tokenize(text)
            cleaned_text = self.clean_text(text)
            
            # 意图识别
            intent = self.detect_intent(text)
            
            # 实体提取
            entities = self.extract_entities(text)
            
            # 语法分析
            syntax = self.analyze_syntax(text)
            
            # 情感分析
            sentiment = self.analyze_sentiment(text)
            
                "original_text": text,
                "cleaned_text": cleaned_text,
                "tokens": tokens,
                "intent": intent.value if hasattr(intent, 'value') else str(intent),
                "entities": entities,
                "syntax": syntax,
                "sentiment": sentiment,
                "confidence": self.calculate_confidence(text, intent, entities),
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
                "error": str(e),
    
    def tokenize(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """分词处理"""
        if self.nlp_model:
            doc = self.nlp_model(text)
            return [token.text for token in doc]
            # 回退到简单分词
            import re
            return re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    
    def clean_text(self, text: str) -> str:
        """文本清洗"""
        # 移除多余空格
        text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()
        # 移除特殊字符
        text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s\u4e00-\u9fff]', '', text)
        return text
    
    def detect_intent(self, text: str) -> IntentType:
        """检测意图"""
        
        for intent_type, keywords in self.intent_classifier.items():
            for keyword in keywords:
                if keyword.lower() in text_lower:
                    return intent_type
        
        # 默认返回通用意图
        return self.IntentType.INFORMATION_QUERY
    
    def extract_entities(self, text: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """提取实体"""
        entities = []
        
        # 使用spaCy提取实体
            for ent in doc.ents:
                entities.append({
                    "text": ent.text,
                    "type": ent.label_,
                    "start": ent.start_char,
                    "end": ent.end_char
        
        # 补充基于规则的实体提取
        for entity_type, values in self.entity_extractor.items():
            for value in values:
                if value in text:
                        "text": value,
                        "type": entity_type,
                        "start": text.find(value),
                        "end": text.find(value) + len(value)
        
        return entities
    
    def analyze_syntax(self, text: str) -> Dict:
        """语法分析"""
        if not self.nlp_model:
            return {"error": "NLP模型未加载"}
        
        
        # 提取句子结构
        syntax_info = {
            "sentences": [],
            "tokens": [],
            "dependencies": []
        
        for sent in doc.sents:
            syntax_info["sentences"].append(str(sent))
            
            for token in sent:
                token_info = {
                    "text": token.text,
                    "lemma": token.lemma_,
                    "pos": token.pos_,
                    "tag": token.tag_,
                    "dep": token.dep_,
                    "head": token.head.text
                syntax_info["tokens"].append(token_info)
                
                # 依存关系
                dep_info = {
                    "governor": token.head.text,
                    "dependent": token.text,
                    "relation": token.dep_
                syntax_info["dependencies"].append(dep_info)
        
        return syntax_info
    
    def analyze_sentiment(self, text: str) -> Dict:
        """情感分析"""
        # 简单基于规则的情感分析
        positive_words = ["好", "喜欢", "高兴", "满意", "棒", "优秀"]
        negative_words = ["坏", "讨厌", "生气", "失望", "差", "糟糕"]
        
        score = 0
        for word in positive_words:
            if word in text:
                score += 1
        for word in negative_words:
                score -= 1
        
        # 确定情感极性
        if score > 0:
            sentiment = "positive"
        elif score < 0:
            sentiment = "negative"
            sentiment = "neutral"
        
            "score": score,
            "polarity": sentiment,
            "positive_words": [w for w in positive_words if w in text],
            "negative_words": [w for w in negative_words if w in text]
    
    def calculate_confidence(self, text: str, intent: IntentType, entities: List[Dict]) -> float:
        """计算分析置信度"""
        # 基于多个因素的置信度计算
        factors = []
        
        # 1. 文本长度因子
        text_length = len(text)
        length_factor = min(text_length / 50, 1.0)  # 长度至少50字符得满分
        factors.append(length_factor * 0.2)
        
        # 2. 实体数量因子
        entity_count = len(entities)
        entity_factor = min(entity_count / 5, 1.0)  # 最多5个实体得满分
        factors.append(entity_factor * 0.3)
        
        # 3. 意图匹配因子（基于关键词匹配）
        intent_matches = 0
        if intent in self.intent_classifier:
            for keyword in self.intent_classifier[intent]:
                    intent_matches += 1
        
        intent_factor = min(intent_matches / 3, 1.0)  # 最多3个关键词匹配得满分
        factors.append(intent_factor * 0.5)
        
        # 计算总置信度
        confidence = sum(factors)
        
        return min(max(confidence, 0.0), 1.0)  # 限制在0-1之间

    def initialize_code_rules(self) -> Dict[str, Callable]:
        """初始化代码规则"""
            "imports": self.generate_imports,
            "function_def": self.generate_function_def,
            "variable_declaration": self.generate_variable_declaration,
            "control_flow": self.generate_control_flow,

    def generate(self, intent: str, parameters: Dict, context: Dict = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """生成代码"""

            template = self.templates.get(intent, [])

                template = self.templates.get("general", [])
            
            # 2. 定制化代码生成
            customized_code = self.customize_template(template, parameters, context)
            
            # 3. 安全检查
            safety_report = self.safety_checker.check_code(customized_code)
            
            # 4. 格式化代码
            formatted_code = self.format_code(customized_code)
            
            # 5. 生成文档
            documentation = self.generate_documentation(intent, parameters)
            
                "status": "success",
                "intent": intent,
                "code": formatted_code,
                "safety_report": safety_report,
                "documentation": documentation,
                "parameters_used": parameters,
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "code_hash": self.calculate_code_hash(formatted_code)
            
                "status": "error",
    
    def customize_template(self, template: List[str], parameters: Dict, context: Dict = None) -> str:
        """定制化模板"""
        code_lines = []
        
            # 参数替换
            for key, value in parameters.items():
                placeholder = f"{{{key}}}"
                if placeholder in line:
                    # 根据参数类型进行适当格式化
                    if isinstance(value, str):
                        line = line.replace(placeholder, f"'{value}'")
                        line = line.replace(placeholder, str(value))
            
            # 条件代码生成
            if "[IF:" in line and context:
                condition_start = line.find("[IF:")
                condition_end = line.find("]", condition_start)
                if condition_start != -1 and condition_end != -1:
                    condition = line[condition_start + 4:condition_end]
                    # 简单的条件检查
                    if condition in context and context[condition]:
                        # 保留条件为真的代码
                        line = line.replace(f"[IF:{condition}]", "")
                        # 跳过这一行
            
            code_lines.append(line)
        
        return "\n".join(code_lines)
    
    def format_code(self, code: str) -> str:
        """格式化代码"""
            import autopep8
            return autopep8.fix_code(code)
        except ImportError:
            # 如果没有autopep8，使用简单格式化
            lines = code.split('\n')
            formatted_lines = []
            indent_level = 0
            
            for line in lines:
                line = line.rstrip()
                
                # 调整缩进
                if line.endswith(':'):
                    formatted_lines.append('    ' * indent_level + line)
                    indent_level += 1
                elif line and line[0] != ' ' and indent_level > 0:
                    # 减少缩进
                    indent_level = max(0, indent_level - 1)
            
            return '\n'.join(formatted_lines)
    
    def generate_documentation(self, intent: str, parameters: Dict) -> Dict:
        """生成代码文档"""
            "purpose": f"执行{intent}任务",
            "generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "parameters": parameters,
            "usage": "调用execute()函数开始执行",
            "dependencies": self.extract_dependencies(intent),
            "safety_notes": "请在安全环境下执行代码",
            "version": SystemConstants.VERSION
    
    def extract_dependencies(self, intent: str) -> List[str]:
        """提取依赖项"""
        dependencies = {
            "object_manipulation": ["robot_controller", "vision_system", "planner"],
            "navigation": ["navigation_system", "slam", "obstacle_detector"],
            "general": ["标准Python库"]
        return dependencies.get(intent, ["标准Python库"])
    
    def calculate_code_hash(self, code: str) -> str:
        """计算代码哈希值"""
        import hashlib
        return hashlib.md5(code.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    # 代码规则生成方法
    def generate_imports(self, modules: List[str]) -> str:
        """生成导入语句"""
        imports = []
        for module in modules:
            imports.append(f"import {module}")
        return "\n".join(imports)
    
    def generate_function_def(self, name: str, params: Dict, return_type: str = "None") -> str:
        """生成函数定义"""
        param_str = ", ".join([f"{k}={repr(v)}" if isinstance(v, str) else f"{k}={v}" 
                              for k, v in params.items()])
        return f"def {name}({param_str}) -> {return_type}:"
    
    def generate_variable_declaration(self, name: str, value: Any, var_type: str = None) -> str:
        """生成变量声明"""
        if var_type:
            return f"{name}: {var_type} = {repr(value) if isinstance(value, str) else value}"
            return f"{name} = {repr(value) if isinstance(value, str) else value}"
    
    def generate_control_flow(self, condition: str, true_block: str, false_block: str = None) -> str:
        """生成控制流"""
        code = f"if {condition}:\n    {true_block.replace('\n', '\n    ')}"
        if false_block:
            code += f"\nelse:\n    {false_block.replace('\n', '\n    ')}"
        return code
    
    def generate_error_handling(self, try_block: str, exception_type: str = "Exception") -> str:
        """生成错误处理"""
        return f"try:\n    {try_block.replace('\n', '\n    ')}\nexcept {exception_type} as e:\n    print(f'错误: {{e}}')"
    
    def generate_logging(self, message: str, level: str = "INFO") -> str:
        """生成日志语句"""
        return f'print("[{level}] {message}")'

# ==================== 安全检查器 ====================
class SafetyChecker:
    """代码安全检查器"""
    
        self.forbidden_patterns = [
            r"__import__\s*\(",
            r"eval\s*\(",
            r"exec\s*\(",
            r"open\s*\([^)]*w[^)]*\)",
            r"subprocess\.",
            r"os\.system\s*\(",
            r"shutil\.",
            r"rm\s+-rf",
            r"delete\s+",
            r"format\s*\("
        
        self.allowed_modules = [
            "math", "numpy", "cv2", "json", "datetime",
            "typing", "pathlib", "logging", "asyncio"
        
        self.max_code_length = 10000  # 最大代码长度
    
    def check_code(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """检查代码安全性"""
        safety_report = {
            "passed": True,
            "issues": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "recommendations": []
        
        # 1. 检查代码长度
        if len(code) > self.max_code_length:
            safety_report["passed"] = False
            safety_report["issues"].append(f"代码过长: {len(code)} 字符 > {self.max_code_length}")
        
        # 2. 检查禁止模式
        for pattern in self.forbidden_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, code, re.IGNORECASE):
                safety_report["issues"].append(f"发现禁止模式: {pattern}")
        
        # 3. 检查导入模块
        import_lines = [line for line in code.split('\n') if line.strip().startswith('import') or line.strip().startswith('from')]
        for line in import_lines:
            # 提取模块名
            if line.startswith('import'):
                module = line.split('import')[1].strip().split()[0].split('.')[0]
            else:  # from module import something
                module = line.split('from')[1].strip().split()[0].split('.')[0]
            
            if module not in self.allowed_modules:
                safety_report["warnings"].append(f"非标准模块导入: {module}")
        
        # 4. 检查语法错误
            compile(code, '<string>', 'exec')
        except SyntaxError as e:
            safety_report["issues"].append(f"语法错误: {e}")
        
        # 5. 检查无限循环模式
        if "while True:" in code and "break" not in code:
            safety_report["warnings"].append("检测到可能的无限循环")
        
        # 6. 添加建议
        if "print(" in code and "logging" not in code:
            safety_report["recommendations"].append("建议使用logging模块替代print进行日志记录")
        
        if not any(pattern in code for pattern in ["try:", "except"]):
            safety_report["recommendations"].append("建议添加异常处理")
        
        return safety_report

# ==================== 机器人控制系统 ====================
class TraeRobotController:
    """Trae机器人控制核心"""
    
    class RobotState(Enum):

        PERCEIVING = "感知环境"
        PLANNING = "路径规划"
        EXECUTING = "执行任务"
        ERROR = "错误"
        SAFETY_STOP = "安全停止"

        self.state = self.RobotState.IDLE
        self.sensors = self.initialize_sensors()

        self.cognitive_modules = self.initialize_cognitive_modules()

                "payload": "100kg"

    def initialize_cognitive_modules(self) -> Dict:

            result = await self.safe_execute(code, execution_env)

            execution_record = {

                "execution_time": execution_time,
                "result": result,
                "performance": self.performance_monitor.get_metrics()
            self.execution_history.append(execution_record)
            
            # 6. 更新状态
            
                "execution_result": result,
                "performance_metrics": self.performance_monitor.get_metrics(),
                "state": self.state.value,
                "record_id": len(self.execution_history) - 1
            
            self.state = self.RobotState.ERROR
                "message": str(e),
    
    def create_execution_environment(self, context: Dict = None) -> Dict:
        """创建执行环境"""
        env = {
            # 系统模块
            "robot": self,
            "vision": self.cognitive_modules["vision"],
            "planning": self.cognitive_modules["planning"],
            "navigation": self.cognitive_modules["navigation"],
            "control": self.cognitive_modules["control"],
            
            # 标准库
            "print": print,
            "len": len,
            "str": str,
            "int": int,
            "float": float,
            "list": list,
            "dict": dict,
            
            # 数学函数
            "math": __import__('math'),
            "numpy": __import__('numpy'),
            
            # 上下文信息
            "context": context or {}
        
        # 安全限制
        env['__builtins__'] = {
            'print': print,
            'len': len,
            'range': range,
            'str': str,
            'int': int,
            'float': float,
            'bool': bool,
            'list': list,
            'dict': dict,
            'tuple': tuple
        
        return env
    
    async def safe_execute(self, code: str, env: Dict) -> Any:
        """安全执行代码"""
            # 编译代码
            compiled_code = compile(code, '<trae_execution>', 'exec')
            
            # 执行代码
            exec(compiled_code, env)
            
            # 检查是否有execute函数
            if 'execute' in env:
                result = env['execute']()
                return {"message": "代码执行完成，但未找到execute函数"}
                
            raise Exception(f"执行错误: {str(e)}")
    
    def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取机器人状态"""
            "simulation_mode": self.simulation_mode,
            "sensors_status": {name: sensor["enabled"] for name, sensor in self.sensors.items()},
            "performance": self.performance_monitor.get_metrics(),
            "execution_history_count": len(self.execution_history),
            "safety_system": self.safety_system.get_status(),

class SafetySystem:

        """获取安全系统状态"""
            "emergency_stop": self.emergency_stop,
            "safety_limits": self.safety_limits,
            "status": "正常" if not self.emergency_stop else "紧急停止"

# ==================== 性能监控器 ====================
class PerformanceMonitor:
    """性能监控器"""
        self.metrics = {
            "cpu_usage": 0.0,
            "memory_usage": 0.0,
            "execution_count": 0,
            "average_execution_time": 0.0,
            "error_rate": 0.0
        self.execution_times = []
        
    def update_metrics(self, execution_time: float, success: bool = True):
        """更新性能指标"""
        self.execution_times.append(execution_time)
        if len(self.execution_times) > 100:
            self.execution_times.pop(0)
        
        self.metrics["execution_count"] += 1
        self.metrics["average_execution_time"] = sum(self.execution_times) / len(self.execution_times)
        
        if not success:
            # 简化错误率计算
            self.metrics["error_rate"] = min(1.0, self.metrics.get("error_rate", 0) + 0.1)
        
        # 模拟CPU和内存使用
        import psutil
        self.metrics["cpu_usage"] = psutil.cpu_percent()
        self.metrics["memory_usage"] = psutil.virtual_memory().percent
    
    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取性能指标"""
        return self.metrics.copy()

# ==================== AI训练系统 ====================
class TraeModelTrainer:
    """Trae模型训练系统"""
    
        self.models = {}
        self.training_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2)
        
    async def start_training(self, data_pool: Dict, model_type: str = "hybrid") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """启动模型训练"""
            training_id = f"training_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
            
            # 记录训练开始
            training_record = {
                "training_id": training_id,
                "start_time": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "model_type": model_type,
                "data_statistics": self.calculate_data_statistics(data_pool),
                "status": "training",
                "progress": 0
            self.training_history.append(training_record)
            
            # 异步执行训练
            training_task = asyncio.create_task(
                self.execute_training(training_id, data_pool, model_type)
            
                "status": "started",
                "message": "训练任务已启动",
                "details": training_record
            
    
    async def execute_training(self, training_id: str, data_pool: Dict, model_type: str):
        """执行训练任务"""
            # 模拟训练过程
            for i in range(1, 101):
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # 模拟训练时间
                
                # 更新进度
                for record in self.training_history:
                    if record["training_id"] == training_id:
                        record["progress"] = i
                        record["current_metrics"] = self.generate_training_metrics(i)
                
                # 每10%输出一次日志
                if i % 10 == 0:
                    print(f"训练进度: {i}%")
            
            # 训练完成
                    record["status"] = "completed"
                    record["end_time"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
                    record["final_metrics"] = {
                        "accuracy": 0.85 + (0.1 * (i / 100)),
                        "loss": 0.1 * (1 - i / 100),
                        "training_time": "模拟10秒"
            
            # 保存模型
            model_key = f"{model_type}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}"
            self.models[model_key] = {
                "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "metrics": record["final_metrics"]
            
            # 训练失败
                    record["status"] = "failed"
                    record["error"] = str(e)
    
    def calculate_data_statistics(self, data_pool: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """计算数据统计"""
        stats = {}
        for key, value in data_pool.items():
            if isinstance(value, list):
                stats[key] = {
                    "count": len(value),
                    "sample_preview": value[:3] if len(value) > 3 else value
            elif isinstance(value, dict):
                    "type": "dict",
                    "keys": list(value.keys())[:5]
        return stats
    
    def generate_training_metrics(self, progress: int) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """生成训练指标"""
        # 模拟指标计算
        base_accuracy = 0.5
        accuracy_gain = 0.4 * (progress / 100)
        
            "accuracy": base_accuracy + accuracy_gain,
            "loss": 1.0 - (base_accuracy + accuracy_gain),
            "learning_rate": 0.001 * (1 - progress / 100),
            "progress": progress / 100
    
    def get_training_status(self, training_id: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取训练状态"""
        if training_id:
                    return record
            return {"error": f"未找到训练记录: {training_id}"}
                "total_trainings": len(self.training_history),
                "recent_trainings": self.training_history[-5:] if self.training_history else [],
                "available_models": list(self.models.keys())

    def analyze_text(self, text: str):
        """分析文本"""
            analysis = self.nlu_engine.analyze(text)
            
            intent = analysis.get("intent", "unknown")
            confidence = analysis.get("confidence", 0)
            entities = analysis.get("entities", [])
            syntax = analysis.get("syntax", {})
            
            # 更新当前分析结果
            self.current_analysis = analysis
            
            return intent, confidence, entities, syntax
            return f"错误: {str(e)}", 0, [], {}
    
    def generate_code(self, text: str, intent: str, safety: bool, formatting: bool):
            # 如果指定了意图，使用指定的意图
            if intent != "自动检测" and intent in self.nlu_engine.intent_classifier:
                detected_intent = intent
                # 自动检测意图
                detected_intent = analysis.get("intent", "general")
            
            # 提取参数
            parameters = {}
            if self.current_analysis.get("entities"):
                for entity in self.current_analysis["entities"]:
                    if entity["type"] in ["OBJECT", "LOCATION"]:
                        parameters[entity["type"].lower()] = entity["text"]
            
            # 添加上下文
            context = {
                "safety_check": safety,
                "formatting": formatting,
                "source_text": text
            
            # 生成代码
            result = self.code_generator.generate(detected_intent, parameters, context)
            
            if result["status"] == "success":
                self.current_code = result["code"]
                return result["code"], result
                return "# 代码生成失败\n" + result.get("error", "未知错误"), result
                
            error_result = {
            return f"# 错误: {str(e)}", error_result

                "processor": platform.processor()
            "resource_usage": {
                "cpu_percent": psutil.cpu_percent(),
                "memory_percent": psutil.virtual_memory().percent,
                "disk_usage": psutil.disk_usage('/').percent
            "process_info": {
                "thread_count": threading.active_count(),
                "process_memory": psutil.Process().memory_info().rss // 1024 // 1024  # MB

# ==================== 主程序入口 ====================
def trae_main():
    """Trae主程序入口"""
    print("=" * 80)
    print(f"🚀 启动 {SystemConstants.PROJECT_NAME} {SystemConstants.VERSION}")
    print(f"📋 Trae兼容性: {SystemConstants.TRAE_COMPATIBILITY}")
    
    # 检查兼容性
    compatibility = check_trae_compatibility()
    print("🔍 兼容性检查报告:")
    for key, value in compatibility.items():
        print(f"  {key}: {value}")
    
    # 初始化系统
    print("\n🔄 初始化系统资源...")
    TraeResourceManager.initialize()
    
    # 创建GUI系统
    print("🎨 创建图形界面...")
    gui_system = TraeHyperMindsGUI()
    
    
    # 启动Gradio服务
        inbrowser=True,
        show_error=True,
        debug=False

def trae_cli_mode():
    """Trae命令行模式"""
    print("输入 'help' 查看命令列表")
    print("输入 'quit' 或 'exit' 退出系统")
    
    # 初始化核心组件
    config = TraeSystemConfig()
    nlu = TraeNLUEngine()
    code_gen = TraeCodeGenerator()
    robot = TraeRobotController(simulation_mode=True)
    
            user_input = input("\n🎯 Trae> ").strip()
            
            elif user_input.lower() == 'help':
                print("可用命令:")
                print("  analyze <文本> - 分析文本意图")
                print("  generate <文本> - 生成代码")
                print("  execute - 执行生成的代码")
                print("  status - 查看系统状态")
                print("  config - 查看配置")
                print("  quit - 退出系统")
            elif user_input.lower() == 'status':
                print("系统状态: 运行中")
                print(f"版本: {SystemConstants.VERSION}")
                print(f"Trae兼容性: {SystemConstants.TRAE_COMPATIBILITY}")
            elif user_input.lower() == 'config':
                print("当前配置:")
                for key, value in config.__dict__.items():
            elif user_input.lower().startswith('analyze '):
                text = user_input[8:].strip()
                if text:
                    result = nlu.analyze(text)
                    print(f"📊 分析结果:")
                    print(f"  意图: {result.get('intent', '未知')}")
                    print(f"  置信度: {result.get('confidence', 0):.2%}")
                    print(f"  实体: {result.get('entities', [])}")
            elif user_input.lower().startswith('generate '):
                text = user_input[9:].strip()
                    # 分析文本
                    analysis = nlu.analyze(text)
                    intent = analysis.get('intent', 'general')
                    
                    # 提取参数
                    for entity in analysis.get('entities', []):
                        if entity.get('type') in ['OBJECT', 'LOCATION']:
                            parameters[entity['type'].lower()] = entity['text']
                    
                    # 生成代码
                    result = code_gen.generate(intent, parameters, analysis)
                    if result['status'] == 'success':
                        print("🔧 生成代码:")
                        print(result['code'])
                        print(f"✅ 代码哈希: {result.get('code_hash', 'N/A')}")
                        print(f"❌ 生成失败: {result.get('error', '未知错误')}")
            elif user_input.lower() == 'execute':
                if hasattr(code_gen, 'current_code'):
                    print("⚡ 执行代码...")
                    # 这里需要实际的执行逻辑
                    print("✅ 执行完成 (模拟)")
                    print("❌ 请先生成代码")
            elif not user_input:
                print("❌ 未知命令，输入 'help' 查看帮助")

    readme = f"""# {SystemConstants.PROJECT_NAME} {SystemConstants.VERSION}

## 🚀 项目概述

HHCPS-OmniNeuro HyperFusion AI System v5.0 是一个超融合全栈自主智能机器人开发平台，专为Trae-AI-IDE和Trae-CN软件优化设计。系统实现了跨模态日常物品到代码的智能转换，支持多模态数据处理、自然语言理解、代码生成和机器人控制。

## 📋 核心特性

### 🧠 智能代码生成
- 自然语言到可执行代码的自动转换
- 多领域代码模板支持
- 实时语法检查和安全性验证

### 📊 多模态数据处理
- 文本、图像、传感器数据的统一处理
- 异步数据吞噬和预处理
- 智能特征提取和融合

### 🤖 机器人控制
- 模拟和真实机器人控制
- 多传感器数据融合
- 安全监控和异常处理

### 🎯 模型训练
- 增量学习和迁移学习支持
- 自动化模型优化
- 性能监控和评估

## 🛠️ 安装使用

### 环境要求
- Python 3.8+
- 16GB+ 内存
- 支持CUDA的GPU (可选)

### 安装步骤

# venv\Scripts\activate  # Windows

# 3. 安装依赖
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 4. 下载NLTK数据

# 5. 运行系统

python main.py --mode cli  # 命令行模式

class Config:
    """系统配置管理类"""
    data_dir = "./data"
    checkpoint_dir = "./checkpoints"
    model_dir = "./models"
    log_dir = "./logs"
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    mixed_precision = True
    batch_size = 32
    epochs = 100
    learning_rate = 1e-4
    distributed = False
    world_size = 1
    api_host = "0.0.0.0"
    api_port = 8000
    
    def update_from_args(cls, args):
        """从命令行参数更新配置"""
        if hasattr(args, 'data_dir') and args.data_dir:
            cls.data_dir = args.data_dir
        if hasattr(args, 'device') and args.device:
            cls.device = args.device
        if hasattr(args, 'batch_size') and args.batch_size:
            cls.batch_size = args.batch_size
        if hasattr(args, 'epochs') and args.epochs:
            cls.epochs = args.epochs

# ========== 设备管理器 ==========
class DeviceManager:
    """智能设备管理类"""
        self.available_gpus = [f"cuda:{i}" for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())]
        self.current_device = None
        logger.info(f"检测到可用GPU设备: {self.available_gpus}")
        
    def auto_select(self):
        """自动选择最优设备"""
        if self.available_gpus:
            self.current_device = self.available_gpus[0]
            logger.info(f"自动选择设备: {self.current_device}")
            return self.current_device
        self.current_device = "cpu"
        logger.info("未检测到GPU，使用CPU设备")
    
    def get_device_info(self):
        """获取设备详细信息"""
        info = {
            "available_gpus": self.available_gpus,
            "current_device": self.current_device,
            "cuda_version": torch.version.cuda if torch.cuda.is_available() else None,
            "cuda_device_count": torch.cuda.device_count(),
            "gpu_memory_info": self._get_gpu_memory_info()
        return info
    
    def _get_gpu_memory_info(self):
        """获取GPU内存信息"""
        memory_info = {}
        for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count()):
                memory_info[f"cuda:{i}"] = {
                    "total_memory": f"{torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i).total_memory / 1024**3:.2f} GB",
                    "allocated_memory": f"{torch.cuda.memory_allocated(i) / 1024**3:.2f} GB",
                    "cached_memory": f"{torch.cuda.memory_reserved(i) / 1024**3:.2f} GB"
                logger.error(f"获取GPU {i} 内存信息失败: {str(e)}")
        return memory_info

# ========== 多模态数据处理器 ==========
class MultiModalProcessor:
    """多模态数据处理核心类"""
    
    def load_text(filepath):
        """加载文本文件"""
            logger.info(f"成功加载文本文件: {filepath}, 长度: {len(content)} 字符")
                "type": "text",
                "content": content,
                "filepath": filepath,
                "size": len(content)
            logger.error(f"加载文本文件失败 {filepath}: {str(e)}")
            return {"type": "text", "content": "", "filepath": filepath, "error": str(e)}

    def load_image(filepath):
        """加载图像文件"""
            image = Image.open(filepath).convert('RGB')
            logger.info(f"成功加载图像文件: {filepath}, 尺寸: {image.size}, 模式: {image.mode}")
                "type": "image",
                "image": image,
                "size": image.size,
                "mode": image.mode
            logger.error(f"加载图像文件失败 {filepath}: {str(e)}")
            return {"type": "image", "image": None, "filepath": filepath, "error": str(e)}

    def load_pdf(filepath):
        """加载PDF文件"""
            doc = fitz.open(filepath)
            text = ""
            pages_info = []
            
            for page_num, page in enumerate(doc):
                page_text = page.get_text()
                text += f"--- 第 {page_num + 1} 页 ---\n{page_text}\n"
                pages_info.append({
                    "page_number": page_num + 1,
                    "text_length": len(page_text),
                    "has_images": len(page.get_images()) > 0
            
            doc.close()
            logger.info(f"成功加载PDF文件: {filepath}, 页数: {len(pages_info)}")
                "type": "pdf",
                "content": text,
                "pages": pages_info,
                "total_pages": len(pages_info)
            logger.error(f"加载PDF文件失败 {filepath}: {str(e)}")
            return {"type": "pdf", "content": "", "filepath": filepath, "error": str(e)}

    def load_table(filepath):
        """加载表格文件"""
            if filepath.endswith('.csv'):
                df = pd.read_csv(filepath)
            elif filepath.endswith('.xlsx'):
                df = pd.read_excel(filepath)
                logger.warning(f"不支持的表格格式: {filepath}")
                
            logger.info(f"成功加载表格文件: {filepath}, 形状: {df.shape}, 列名: {list(df.columns)}")
                "type": "table",
                "dataframe": df,
                "shape": df.shape,
                "columns": list(df.columns),
                "sample_data": df.head().to_dict()
            logger.error(f"加载表格文件失败 {filepath}: {str(e)}")
            return {"type": "table", "dataframe": None, "filepath": filepath, "error": str(e)}

    def process_file(self, filepath):
        """统一文件处理方法"""
        filepath = Path(filepath)
        if not filepath.exists():
            logger.error(f"文件不存在: {filepath}")
            
        ext = filepath.suffix.lower()
        logger.info(f"开始处理文件: {filepath}, 类型: {ext}")
        
        if ext in ['.txt', '.md', '.json']:
            return self.load_text(filepath)
        elif ext in ['.jpg', '.png', '.jpeg', '.bmp', '.tiff']:
            return self.load_image(filepath)
        elif ext == '.pdf':
            return self.load_pdf(filepath)
        elif ext in ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.xls']:
            return self.load_table(filepath)
            logger.warning(f"不支持的文件类型: {ext}")

# ========== 自定义数据集类 ==========
class MultiModalDataset(Dataset):
    """多模态数据集类"""
    def __init__(self, data_dir, processor, transform=None):
        self.data_dir = Path(data_dir)
        self.processor = processor
        self.transform = transform
        self.samples = self._discover_samples()
        self._create_index()
        
    def _discover_samples(self):
        """发现所有数据样本"""
        samples = []
        extensions = ['*.txt', '*.md', '*.json', '*.jpg', '*.png', '*.jpeg', '*.pdf', '*.csv', '*.xlsx']
        
        for ext in extensions:
                files = list(self.data_dir.rglob(ext))
                samples.extend(files)
                logger.info(f"发现 {len(files)} 个 {ext} 文件")
                logger.error(f"扫描 {ext} 文件时出错: {str(e)}")
                
        logger.info(f"总共发现 {len(samples)} 个数据样本")
        return samples
    
    def _create_index(self):
        """创建数据索引"""
        self.index = {}
        for idx, sample in enumerate(self.samples):
            self.index[str(sample)] = idx
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        """获取数据样本"""
        if isinstance(idx, str):
            # 通过文件路径获取
            if idx in self.index:
                idx = self.index[idx]
                raise KeyError(f"文件路径不存在: {idx}")
                
        filepath = self.samples[idx]
        result = self.processor.process_file(filepath)
        
        if result is None:
            logger.warning(f"无法处理文件: {filepath}")
                'filepath': str(filepath),
                'data': None,
                'type': 'unknown',
                'error': 'Processing failed'
            
            'data': result,
            'type': result.get('type', 'unknown'),
            'processed_time': datetime.now().isoformat()
    
    def get_stats(self):
        """获取数据集统计信息"""
            'total_samples': len(self.samples),
            'file_types': {},
            'total_size_bytes': 0
        
        for sample in self.samples:
            ext = sample.suffix.lower()
            stats['file_types'][ext] = stats['file_types'].get(ext, 0) + 1
                stats['total_size_bytes'] += sample.stat().st_size
            except:
                
        stats['total_size_mb'] = stats['total_size_bytes'] / (1024 * 1024)

# ========== 实时文件监控 ==========
class FileMonitor(FileSystemEventHandler):
    """实时文件监控处理器"""
    def __init__(self, processor, callback=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.callback = callback
        self.processed_files = set()
        logger.info("文件监控器初始化完成")

    def on_created(self, event):
        """文件创建事件处理"""
        if not event.is_directory:
            filepath = event.src_path
            logger.info(f"检测到新文件创建: {filepath}")
            self._process_with_delay(filepath)

    def on_modified(self, event):
        """文件修改事件处理"""
            logger.info(f"检测到文件修改: {filepath}")

    def on_moved(self, event):
        """文件移动事件处理"""
            logger.info(f"检测到文件移动: {event.src_path} -> {event.dest_path}")
            self._process_with_delay(event.dest_path)

    def _process_with_delay(self, filepath, delay=1):
        """延迟处理文件，避免文件未完全写入"""
        def process():
            time.sleep(delay)
            self.process_file(filepath)
        
        threading.Thread(target=process, daemon=True).start()

    def process_file(self, path):
        """处理文件"""
        filepath = Path(path)
            logger.warning(f"文件不存在，跳过处理: {path}")
            return
            
        # 避免重复处理
        file_id = f"{filepath}_{filepath.stat().st_mtime}"
        if file_id in self.processed_files:
            logger.debug(f"文件已处理过，跳过: {path}")
            
            result = self.processor.process_file(path)
            if result and 'error' not in result:
                self.processed_files.add(file_id)
                logger.info(f"成功处理文件: {path}")
                
                if self.callback:
                    self.callback(path, result)
                logger.warning(f"文件处理失败: {path}")
                
            logger.error(f"处理文件 {path} 时出错: {str(e)}")

# ========== 自修复模型基类 ==========
class SelfHealingModel(nn.Module):
    """自修复模型基类"""
    def __init__(self, input_size=784, hidden_size=512, num_classes=10):
        self.safe_mode = False
        self.recovery_attempts = 0
        self.max_recovery_attempts = 3
        
        # 模型层定义
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(input_size, hidden_size)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_classes)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_size)
        
        logger.info(f"自修复模型初始化: input_size={input_size}, hidden_size={hidden_size}, num_classes={num_classes}")

    def forward(self, x):
        """前向传播 with 自修复机制"""
            if self.safe_mode:
                with torch.no_grad():
                    return self._forward_impl(x)
            logger.error(f"模型前向传播错误: {str(e)}")
            return self._recover_from_error(x, e)

    def _forward_impl(self, x):
        """实际的前向传播实现"""
        # 确保输入是二维的
        if x.dim() > 2:
            x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
            
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = torch.relu(x)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

    def _recover_from_error(self, x, error):
        """错误恢复机制"""
        if self.recovery_attempts < self.max_recovery_attempts:
            self.recovery_attempts += 1
            self.safe_mode = True
            logger.warning(f"激活安全模式，恢复尝试 {self.recovery_attempts}/{self.max_recovery_attempts}")
            
            # 尝试简化处理
                    # 简化前向传播
                    x_flat = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
                    # 只使用第一层
                    simplified_output = self.fc1(x_flat)
                    logger.info("安全模式前向传播成功")
                    return simplified_output
                logger.error(f"安全模式也失败: {str(e)}")
                # 返回零张量作为最后的保障
                return torch.zeros(x.size(0), self.fc2.out_features, device=x.device)
            logger.error(f"超过最大恢复尝试次数，返回零输出")

    def reset_recovery_mode(self):
        """重置恢复模式"""
        logger.info("模型恢复模式已重置")

# ========== 知识蒸馏框架 ==========
class TeacherModel(SelfHealingModel):
    """教师模型 - 复杂网络"""
    def __init__(self, input_size=784, hidden_size=1024, num_classes=10):
        super().__init__(input_size, hidden_size, num_classes)
        # 添加额外层
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_size // 2)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_size // 2, num_heads=8)
        
        """教师模型前向传播"""
        
        # 第一层
        
        # 第二层
        x = self.fc3(x)
        x = self.bn2(x)
        
        # 输出层
        return torch.softmax(x, dim=1)

class StudentModel(SelfHealingModel):
    """学生模型 - 轻量网络"""
    def __init__(self, input_size=784, hidden_size=256, num_classes=10):
        # 学生模型使用更小的隐藏层
        
        """学生模型前向传播"""
        x = torch.relu(self.fc1(x))
        return torch.log_softmax(x, dim=1)

class DistillationTrainer:
    """知识蒸馏训练器"""
    def __init__(self, teacher, student, config):
        self.teacher = teacher.to(config.device)
        self.student = student.to(config.device)
        self.device = config.device
        
        # 优化器
        self.optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
            self.student.parameters(), 
            lr=config.learning_rate,
            weight_decay=1e-5
        
        # 学习率调度器
        self.scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(self.optimizer, step_size=30, gamma=0.1)
        
        # 混合精度训练
        self.scaler = GradScaler(enabled=config.mixed_precision)
        
        # 损失函数
        self.kl_loss = nn.KLDivLoss(reduction='batchmean')
        self.ce_loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        
        # 训练状态
        self.training_history = {
            'loss': [],
            'teacher_accuracy': [],
            'student_accuracy': []
        
        logger.info("知识蒸馏训练器初始化完成")

    def train_step(self, data):
        """单步训练"""
        # 准备数据
        inputs = self._prepare_inputs(data)
        if inputs is None:
            
        self.optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        with autocast(enabled=self.config.mixed_precision):
            # 教师模型预测 (不计算梯度)
                teacher_outputs = self.teacher(inputs)
            
            # 学生模型预测
            student_outputs = self.student(inputs)
            
            # 知识蒸馏损失
            distillation_loss = self.kl_loss(
                student_outputs, 
                teacher_outputs.detach()
            
            # 总损失
            loss = distillation_loss
            
        # 反向传播
        self.scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        self.scaler.step(self.optimizer)
        self.scaler.update()
        
        return loss.item()

    def _prepare_inputs(self, data):
        """准备输入数据"""
        if data is None or data.get('data') is None:
            
        data_content = data['data']
        
        # 根据数据类型生成模拟输入
        if data_content.get('type') == 'text':
            # 文本数据: 使用随机嵌入
            batch_size = self.config.batch_size
            return torch.randn(batch_size, 784, device=self.device)
        elif data_content.get('type') == 'image':
            # 图像数据: 使用随机图像张量
            return torch.randn(batch_size, 3, 224, 224, device=self.device)
            # 其他数据类型使用默认输入

    def train(self, dataloader, epochs=None):
        """完整训练流程"""
        epochs = epochs or self.config.epochs
        logger.info(f"开始知识蒸馏训练，共 {epochs} 个epochs")
        
        for epoch in range(epochs):
            self.teacher.eval()
            self.student.train()
            
            epoch_loss = 0
            batch_count = 0
            
            for batch_idx, batch_data in enumerate(dataloader):
                loss = self.train_step(batch_data)
                if loss is not None:
                    epoch_loss += loss
                    batch_count += 1
                
                if batch_idx % 10 == 0:
                    logger.info(f"Epoch: {epoch+1}/{epochs}, Batch: {batch_idx}, Loss: {loss if loss else 'N/A'}")
            
            if batch_count > 0:
                avg_loss = epoch_loss / batch_count
                self.training_history['loss'].append(avg_loss)
                
                # 更新学习率
                self.scheduler.step()
                current_lr = self.scheduler.get_last_lr()[0]
                
                logger.info(f"Epoch {epoch+1} 完成，平均损失: {avg_loss:.4f}, 学习率: {current_lr:.6f}")
                logger.warning(f"Epoch {epoch+1} 没有有效数据")
        
        logger.info("知识蒸馏训练完成")
        return self.training_history

    def save_checkpoint(self, filepath):
        """保存训练检查点"""
        checkpoint = {
            'student_state_dict': self.student.state_dict(),
            'teacher_state_dict': self.teacher.state_dict(),
            'optimizer_state_dict': self.optimizer.state_dict(),
            'scheduler_state_dict': self.scheduler.state_dict(),
            'training_history': self.training_history,
            'epoch': len(self.training_history['loss'])
        torch.save(checkpoint, filepath)
        logger.info(f"训练检查点已保存: {filepath}")

    def load_checkpoint(self, filepath):
        """加载训练检查点"""
        if os.path.exists(filepath):
            checkpoint = torch.load(filepath, map_location=self.device)
            self.student.load_state_dict(checkpoint['student_state_dict'])
            self.teacher.load_state_dict(checkpoint['teacher_state_dict'])
            self.optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint['optimizer_state_dict'])
            self.scheduler.load_state_dict(checkpoint['scheduler_state_dict'])
            self.training_history = checkpoint['training_history']
            logger.info(f"训练检查点已加载: {filepath}")
            logger.warning(f"检查点文件不存在: {filepath}")

# ========== 分布式训练支持 ==========
def setup_distributed():
    """分布式训练初始化"""
        if not dist.is_initialized():
            dist.init_process_group(backend='nccl')
            local_rank = int(os.environ.get('LOCAL_RANK', 0))
            Config.device = f'cuda:{local_rank}'
            Config.world_size = dist.get_world_size()
            Config.distributed = True
            logger.info(f"分布式训练初始化完成，设备: {Config.device}, 世界大小: {Config.world_size}")
            logger.info("分布式训练已初始化")
        logger.error(f"分布式训练初始化失败: {str(e)}")
        Config.distributed = False

def cleanup_distributed():
    """清理分布式训练"""
    if dist.is_initialized():
        dist.destroy_process_group()
        logger.info("分布式训练已清理")

@app.post("/start_training", response_model=dict)
async def start_training(request: TrainingRequest):
    """启动训练"""
    
    if training_active:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="训练正在进行中")
    
        training_active = True
        
        # 更新配置
        Config.epochs = request.epochs
        Config.batch_size = request.batch_size
        Config.learning_rate = request.learning_rate
        Config.mixed_precision = request.use_mixed_precision
        
        logger.info(f"开始训练，配置: {request.dict()}")
        
        # 初始化模型
        teacher = TeacherModel()
        student = StudentModel()
        trainer = DistillationTrainer(teacher, student, Config)
        current_trainer = trainer
        
        # 准备数据
        processor = MultiModalProcessor()
        dataset = MultiModalDataset(Config.data_dir, processor)
        
        if len(dataset) == 0:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="数据目录中没有找到可用的训练数据")
        
        dataloader = DataLoader(
            dataset, 
            batch_size=Config.batch_size, 
            shuffle=True,
            num_workers=2
        
        # 异步执行训练
        asyncio.create_task(run_training_async(trainer, dataloader))
        
            "message": "训练已开始",
            "config": request.dict(),
            "data_info": dataset.get_stats(),
            "start_time": datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        logger.error(f"启动训练失败: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"训练启动失败: {str(e)}")

async def run_training_async(trainer, dataloader):
    """异步运行训练"""
    global training_active
        trainer.train(dataloader)
        
        # 保存训练结果
        os.makedirs(Config.checkpoint_dir, exist_ok=True)
        checkpoint_path = os.path.join(
            Config.checkpoint_dir, 
            f"distillation_checkpoint_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.pth"
        trainer.save_checkpoint(checkpoint_path)
        
        logger.info("训练完成")
        logger.error(f"训练过程出错: {str(e)}")
    finally:

@app.post("/upload", response_model=FileUploadResponse)
async def upload_file(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    """文件上传接口"""
        # 确保数据目录存在
        os.makedirs(Config.data_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # 验证文件类型
        allowed_extensions = {'.txt', '.md', '.json', '.jpg', '.png', '.jpeg', '.pdf', '.csv', '.xlsx'}
        file_extension = Path(file.filename).suffix.lower()
        
        if file_extension not in allowed_extensions:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400, 
                detail=f"不支持的文件类型: {file_extension}. 支持的类型: {allowed_extensions}"
        
        # 保存文件
        file_location = os.path.join(Config.data_dir, file.filename)
        with open(file_location, "wb") as f:
            content = await file.read()
            f.write(content)
        
        file_size = len(content)
        logger.info(f"文件上传成功: {file.filename}, 大小: {file_size} 字节")
        
        return FileUploadResponse(
            status="success",
            filename=file.filename,
            saved_path=file_location,
            message="文件上传成功",
            file_type=file_extension,
            file_size=file_size
        
    except HTTPException:
        raise
        logger.error(f"文件上传失败: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"文件上传失败: {str(e)}")

        # 更新配置
        if args:
            self.config.update_from_args(args)
            
        self._init_components()
        logger.info("Bunny全栈式智能训练系统初始化完成")
        
    def _init_components(self):
        """初始化所有组件"""
        # 确保目录存在
        os.makedirs(self.config.data_dir, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.config.checkpoint_dir, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.config.model_dir, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.config.log_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # 设备初始化
        self.config.device = self.dev_mgr.auto_select()
        logger.info(f"系统使用设备: {self.config.device}")
        
        # 分布式训练设置
        if self.config.distributed:
            setup_distributed()
            
        # 文件监控初始化
        event_handler = FileMonitor(self.processor, self._on_file_processed)
        self.file_monitor.schedule(
            event_handler, 
            self.config.data_dir, 
            recursive=True
        
    def _on_file_processed(self, filepath, data):
        """文件处理完成回调"""
        logger.info(f"文件处理回调: {filepath}, 类型: {data.get('type', 'unknown')}")
        
        # 这里可以添加进一步的处理逻辑
        # 比如触发自动训练、数据预处理等
        if data.get('type') in ['text', 'image', 'pdf', 'table']:
            logger.info(f"有效数据文件已就绪: {filepath}")
            
    def run(self):
        """运行系统"""
            logger.info("启动Bunny全栈式智能训练系统...")
            
            # 启动文件监控
            self.file_monitor.start()
            logger.info(f"文件监控已启动，监控目录: {self.config.data_dir}")
            
            # 显示系统信息
            self._show_system_info()
            
            # 启动API服务
            logger.info(f"启动FastAPI服务: {self.config.api_host}:{self.config.api_port}")
            uvicorn.run(
                app, 
                host=self.config.api_host, 
                port=self.config.api_port, 
                log_level="info"
            
            logger.info("接收到中断信号，正在关闭系统...")
            self.shutdown()
            logger.error(f"系统运行错误: {str(e)}")
    
    def _show_system_info(self):
        """显示系统信息"""
        device_info = self.dev_mgr.get_device_info()
        dataset = MultiModalDataset(self.config.data_dir, self.processor)
        
        logger.info("=" * 50)
        logger.info("Bunny全栈式智能训练系统 v13.0")
        logger.info(f"设备信息: {device_info['current_device']}")
        logger.info(f"可用GPU: {len(device_info['available_gpus'])}")
        logger.info(f"数据样本: {data_stats['total_samples']}")
        logger.info(f"数据大小: {data_stats['total_size_mb']:.2f} MB")
        logger.info(f"文件类型: {data_stats['file_types']}")
        logger.info(f"API地址: http://{self.config.api_host}:{self.config.api_port}")
    
    def shutdown(self):
        """优雅关闭系统"""
        logger.info("正在关闭系统...")
        self.file_monitor.stop()
        self.file_monitor.join()
        
            cleanup_distributed()
            
        logger.info("系统已安全关闭")

    """主函数"""
